jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Software Systems
jobs.description:
The Meta Infra Technical Program Management (TPM) community is pioneering technologies to bring people and businesses closer together at a global scale. Infra TPMs are the enablers for our toughest business strategies to become technical realities, requiring direct and close partnership with both Engineering and Product teams to make products come to life with incredible scale, reliability, and efficiency.Meta's infrastructure software stack is being upgraded for a world where the primary consumer of our platforms is an agent, not a human at a terminal, and our core infrastructure stack is being upgraded for the rigor, speed, and scale required of modern training, inferencing, and app development. These shifts change how we design APIs and interfaces, how we onboard and support internal and external partners, how we plan features, and how we measure adoption and success. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to own that transformation for a major surface of Meta's Infra software stack.In this role, you will partner with Engineering and Product leadership to shape the technical roadmap for the platforms you own, drive the design and rollout of the interfaces those platforms expose, and own end-to-end delivery and adoption with the partner teams who build on top of them. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy on ambiguous, cross-organizational problems turning open-ended strategic questions into concrete programs with a credible path to success and you will set the technical program management standard for the teams around you.

Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Software Systems Responsibilities:

Own technical program management for a core area of Meta's infrastructure software stack, spanning platform strategy, technical design, delivery, and partner adoption
Partner with Engineering and Product to define the multi-quarter roadmap: shaping feature plans, participating substantively in technical design and API/interface design reviews, and making tradeoff recommendations that leadership acts on
Drive platform adoption end to end — defining the onboarding path for partner teams, removing friction in integration, and holding the bar on the partner experience from first evaluation through steady-state production use
Translate the needs of demanding internal customer organizations into platform requirements, and broker the prioritization conversations required to land them
Define and instrument the metrics that determine whether the platform is succeeding — adoption, reliability, efficiency, and developer/agent effectiveness — and use them to drive decisions rather than to report status
Lead technical discussions and act as a thought leader in program and design reviews
be the cross-functional partner engineering leaders pull into their hardest problems
Identify and solve systemic problems that span organizational boundaries, and build the lightweight operational constructs that accelerate team momentum without adding overhead
Perform risk assessment, risk mitigation, and change management across a portfolio of concurrent technical programs
Articulate technical vision, requirements, goals, and milestones to stakeholders up to and including VP-level leadership
Provide hands-on program management through design, development, testing, rollout, and post-launch phases
Mentor and raise the bar for other technical program managers, and influence how TPM is practiced across the broader organization

Minimum Qualifications:

12+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or technical product/program management
Experience delivering technical platforms or infrastructure software programs from inception through production adoption
Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional programs with significant organizational impact
Experience driving strategic technical initiatives and influencing roadmaps across multiple engineering teams
Experience with platform or developer-facing software, including API and interface design, partner onboarding, and adoption of a platform by teams outside the one that builds it
Experience working with AI/ML or agentic systems, and translating their requirements into platform and infrastructure decisions
Experience with executive-level communication, including presenting to and influencing senior leadership
Experience navigating ambiguity and defining structure for complex, multi-quarter technical programs
Experience communicating and translating between non-technical and technical requirements and audiences
Experience mentoring and developing other technical program managers
Experience establishing working relationships across multi-disciplinary teams and partners in multiple time zones

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience building or operating agent-facing platforms, tooling, or APIs, including agent orchestration and evaluation
Experience partnering with large internal customer organizations to migrate them onto a shared platform
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience defining and driving developer or platform effectiveness metrics
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize or redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Experience supporting AI/ML infrastructure — training, inference serving, or the software layers that sit on top of them

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

$199,000/year to $272,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About The Role

Suno is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to help us scale our technical programs and launches - coordinating across engineering, product, and other functions to land some of our largest initiatives. As a Staff TPM, you’ll have the ability to create and drive programs, and partner with us to figure out where we should be investing that we aren’t today. TPM as a function is new to Suno, and there’s a real opportunity to help us build it from the ground up

What You'll Do

Lead cross-functional programs end to end — things like model launches, multi-team engineering efforts, and engineering initiatives — from scoping, through rollout, and tracking
Coach and grow the team's TPM, building the mentorship and structure that hasn't existed here before
Help shape what "TPM" means at Suno — the working model, the organizing principles, and where the function needs to grow
Partner closely with engineering leadership so cross-functional continues to move fast and collaboration is easy, contributing directly to team velocity
Help turn Suno's mission — making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone — into shipped, coordinated reality across teams

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

8–10 years in program or technical program management
Demonstrated adaptability — you find the right approach for the environment you're in rather than importing what worked somewhere else
A clear, articulable framework for how you evaluate and measure whether a program is actually succeeding
Enough technical/coding fluency to get hands-on and understand the work that needs to be done, not just coordinate around it

Nice-to-Haves

Track record of building a program from zero in genuine ambiguity and landing it
Experience coaching or mentoring other program managers
Background at a consumer tech company, a high-scale tech company, or a hypergrowth scale-up
Experience coordinating launches for AI or ML-driven products

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits For Full-Time Employees

Company Equity Package
401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)
11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time
16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Creative Education Stipend
Generous Commuter Allowance
In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $230,000 - $300,000 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, New Product Development
jobs.description:
Tract Capital adopts a unique approach to digital infrastructure investment. Leveraging experience and strategic insights honed over three decades of creating successful companies in the space, we excel in nurturing and advancing leading-edge digital infrastructure enterprises. Our team of specialized experts are united by a singular purpose: to support the growth of digital infrastructure. Tract Capital goes beyond simple investment by acting as a strategic partner and catalyst for innovation within the sector. We ensure our engagements not only generate strong financial results but also develop essential digital infrastructure to meet growing demands.

Position Overview

The Principal Technical Program Manager, New Product Development leads the most complex and business-critical product development programs supporting data center infrastructure. This role partners closely with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Construction, Commissioning, and Operations teams to drive products from concept through design, validation, pilot, launch, and scaled production, while also shaping the operating model used across multiple programs.

The Principal Technical Program Manager owns integrated program strategy, executive-level governance, schedules, risks, dependencies, and decision frameworks required to deliver high-quality, manufacturable products aligned with performance, cost, safety, and timeline objectives. This role ensures the right teams are aligned at the right time, that key technical and operational issues are surfaced early, and that execution remains disciplined across internal stakeholders and external partners.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Strategy & Scale

Define end-to-end manufacturing strategy, including make-vs-buy decisions, manufacturing footprint, partner selection, capacity planning, and regional deployment strategy.
Evaluate tradeoffs across cost, quality, lead time, logistics, supply chain risk, automation opportunities, and customer requirements.
Develop manufacturing roadmaps supporting new product introduction, production ramp-up, and long-term scaling.

Process, Automation & Industrialization

Establish manufacturing methods, tooling, fixtures, test systems, production flows, and equipment strategies.
Lead adoption of advanced manufacturing technologies including robotics, automation, machine vision, digital work instructions, and data-driven process controls.
Partner with engineering teams to ensure products are designed for manufacturability, testability, serviceability, and production scale.

Operations & Performance

Build production systems that achieve throughput, cycle time, labor efficiency, and capacity targets.
Lead pilot builds, process validation, production readiness, staffing plans, and volume production transitions.
Implement KPIs and dashboards to monitor yields, schedule attainment, bottlenecks, and overall manufacturing performance.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

Define manufacturing quality strategies, in-process controls, testing requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for manufacturing, supplier, and field quality issues.
Drive improvements in first-pass yield, defect reduction, process capability, and operational discipline.

Workforce & Partner Leadership

Develop scalable training programs, work instructions, certification requirements, and operating procedures.
Lead relationships with contract manufacturers, OEMs, integrators, equipment suppliers, and automation partners.
Drive partner performance across quality, cost, capacity, responsiveness, and delivery metrics.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the manufacturing leader across Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Program Management, Operations, and Customer Delivery.
Provide executive-level recommendations on manufacturing investments, risks, sourcing strategies, and scaling opportunities.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or related field.
10+ years of manufacturing, operations, industrialization, or advanced manufacturing experience.
5+ years leading manufacturing strategy, process development, or production scale-up for complex hardware products.
Proven experience with manufacturing footprint decisions, automation strategies, contract manufacturing, OEM partnerships, and production system design.
Track record improving quality, throughput, capacity, and on-time delivery.
Experience launching products from prototype or pilot production into volume manufacturing.

Preferred

Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or Business.
Experience with data center infrastructure, thermal systems, liquid cooling, HVAC, power distribution, or mission-critical equipment.
Experience implementing robotics, automation, and advanced manufacturing technologies.
Knowledge of global manufacturing strategies, supply chain risk management, and multi-site production scaling.
Experience in highly regulated, safety-critical, or uptime-sensitive environments.

Travel

Required to manufacturing facilities, supplier sites, test labs, and deployment locations. This role requires strong strategic judgment, operational rigor, and the ability to shape the long-term manufacturing model of a rapidly growing digital infrastructure business.

Expected Salary Range

$150,000 - $200,000 + Discretionary Bonus

Tract Capital Employment

Tract Capital employees enjoy competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including 100% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, standard paid holidays, and unlimited PTO.

NOTE:
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other related duties to meet the organization's ongoing needs.

Tract Capital is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status. If you need assistance applying for any of our open positions, please contact us at info@tract.com

Experience working with classified IT environments (e.g., SAP/SAR, TS, SCIF/closed area environments), including coordination with cybersecurity, ISSM/ISSO, and facilities/security teams

Strong skills in stakeholder engagement and communication, including the ability to translate technical IT topics into clear program‑level risk, schedule, and cost impacts.

Active Top Secret clearance and current or recent SAP/SAR accesses.
Experience supporting I-RAD, G-RAD, or other similar development programs.
Hands‑on experience with NGPCN or other enterprise classified IT services.
Familiarity with RMF/JSIG, ATO processes, and working across AO/DAO and customer security organizations.
Experience interfacing with CIDO, Classified Solutions, and enterprise IT organizations in a matrixed environment.
Strong background in requirements capture and demand management for IT services (e.g., using ServiceNow or similar tools).

jobs.description:
Job Description

We’re on a journey to advance how health happens with technologies that support clinicians, inspire innovation, empower patients, and save lives. Our mission? To create a human-centric healthcare experience powered by unified global data.

It’s a big challenge, but big challenges are what we do best. We’re already transforming some of the world’s largest health systems—helping them turn data into lifesaving decisions and better patient care.

We want people just as dedicated as we are making history with the advancement of Federal Healthcare systems. If you’re excited about making healthcare more human, you’ve come to the right place.

Oracle Health Government Services is seeking a skilled Federal Program Manager to join our mission-driven organization. In this role, you will be responsible for leading program activities and ensuring successful delivery across Oracle’s risk management framework.

The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of federal contracting rules and regulations and be comfortable operating within a highly regulated environment. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams—both internal stakeholders and client partners—so familiarity with systems development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies, business process re-engineering, and program management best practices is essential for applying our risk management framework. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving Oracle Health’s risk management framework in support of our federal client. This role requires a strong combination of risk management experience, project management expertise, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving skills to create effective mitigation plans and action plans. You will work closely with Program Managers, Project Managers, Application support teams, Infrastructure teams, internal and external stakeholders, and government partners to coordinate deliverables, resolve dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure successful project outcomes.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities for this role include:

Data analysis. Analyzing data to formulate risk and issue identification for effective mitigation management.
Forecasting trends. Reviewing task order scope to proactively identify potential risks and issues based on data from previous deployments.
Risk Strategy. Partner with Task Order Owners to help formulate risk mitigation and issue resolution strategies to reduce the probability and impact of thematic risks across scope, schedule, and cost.
Risk Management. Manage a portfolio of risks and issues for multiple, concurrent task orders focused on the following:
Risk and Issue Tracking. Ensure risks and issues are tracked in the appropriate tools and ensure the risk/issue task order portfolio is up to date.
Risk and Issue Reporting. Ensure all risk reporting (client deliverables and internal deliverables) is timely, accurate, and complete.
Risk and Issue Controls. In partnership with Task Order Owners, establish weekly/bi-weekly review meetings to review the risk portfolio status.
Risk and Issue Management Lifecycle. Management of an assigned risk portfolio across deployment and/or non-deployment markets from Risk Identification, Risk Assessment, Risk Monitoring and Control, and Risk Closure

Continuous improvement. Periodically review Oracle Health’s risk management framework, processes, tools, and policies and offer improvements to increase efficiency, improve scalability, and reduce cost.
Internal strategy. In partnership with Oracle Health risk leadership, contribute towards the internal strategy and ways of working (e.g. RACI) for successful management of the risk function.
Mentorship. Provide mentorship to other risk analysts though informal coaching and support.

The qualifications for this role include:

Eight to ten years of large-scale program and project management.
Ability to meet applicable federal security clearance requirements, such as Public Trust or Secret clearance eligibility.
Prior project team leadership or management experience.
Comfortable working in a matrix management environment with multiple stakeholders.
Strong communication skills with internal stakeholders, external stakeholders, clients, and vendors.
Undergraduate degree strongly preferred. Masters Degree a plus.
PMP credential from PMI strongly preferred.
Travel up to 20%
U.S. citizenship required due to client contracts.
Must be able to obtain the appropriate government security clearance card applicable to your position.

Qualifications

Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
Short term disability and long term disability
Life insurance and AD&D
Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
11 paid holidays

Paid parental leave
Adoption assistance
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. jobs.description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

jobs.title: IT Security Operations Manager
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Digital, Cyber & Information Security

Københavns Lufthavn

Vil du have ansvaret for den IT sikkerhedsdrift og overvågning, der beskytter Danmarks største lufthavn døgnet rundt? Som SecOps Manager leder du et specialiseret team og sætter retning for cyberhændelser, trusler og sårbarheder på tværs af IT, OT (operationel teknologi) og forretning. Du får mulighed for at udvikle området i samarbejde med Cyber & Information Security, it-driften og forretningen.

Din nye rolle

Du får personaleansvar for IT Security Operations med reference til CISO. Teamets specialister arbejder med cyberhændelser, it-sikkerhedsdrift, trusselsinformation, sårbarhedsstyring og penetrationstest. Du skal sætte retning for området, øge den operationelle robusthed og sikre, at risikobaserede prioriteringer bliver omsat til handling. Du kombinerer personaleledelse med operationelt ansvar, skaber fremdrift og samarbejde og træder til, når alvorlige cyberhændelser kræver det, også uden for normal arbejdstid.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

Sætte retning, udvikle og prioritere teamets arbejde med klare mål, trivsel og fremdrift
Sikre overvågning, håndtering og opfølgning på cyberhændelser i samspil med vores øvrige drift og beredskab
Udvikle sikkerhedsprocesser, værktøjer og services
Varetage leverandørsamarbejde, kontrakter og udbud
Sætte retning for trusselsinformation og omsætte trusselsbilledet til operationelle prioriteringer og handlinger
Varetage ansvaret for risikobaseret sårbarhedsstyring og penetrationstest på tværs af IT, OT og forretning
Etablere mål, rapportering og forbedringer, der synliggør risici, resultater og teamets udvikling
Samarbejde med governance, risk, compliance, arkitektur, it-drift og forretningen om at omsætte krav, risici og arkitekturprincipper til robuste operationelle løsninger.

Din nye afdeling

I Digital er data og teknologi en central faktor i udviklingen af CPH. Vi har ansvaret for de systemer og digitale løsninger, der får lufthavnen til at fungere – fra stabil drift og it-sikkerhed til data, automatisering, AI og udvikling af nye digitale services.

Du bliver en del af en innovativ og datadrevet organisation, hvor vi arbejder på tværs af forretningen for at gøre hverdagen lettere for kolleger og samarbejdspartnere og skabe smidige og sammenhængende oplevelser for passagererne.

IT Security Operations er en del af Cyber & Information Security. Her er arbejdet omkring governance, risikostyring, compliance, arkitektur og security operations samlet og vi arbejder med både IT og OT infrastruktur. Du indgår i ledergruppen og vi arbejder med cybersikkerhed på tværs af alle teams og med at samle vores indsatser, så de giver mest mulig værdi.

Om dig

Du er en tydelig leder, der skaber retning, når prioriteringer ændrer sig. Du er tæt på fagligheden, støtter specialisterne og fastholder det samlede ansvar. Du kommunikerer enkelt og præcist.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har dokumenteret erfaring med ledelse af Security Operations, Security Operations Center, eller et tilsvarende cybersikkerhedsområde
Har solid forståelse for cyberhændelser, sikkerhedsovervågning, trusselsinformation, sårbarhedsstyring og penetrationstest
Kan skabe struktur, prioritere og gennemføre forbedringer i et komplekst miljø med høje krav til stabilitet og tilgængelighed
Kan være spillende træner uden at miste fokus på ledelsesopgaven
Kommunikerer flydende på dansk
Har erfaring med operationel teknologi, kritisk infrastruktur, regulerede miljøer, NIS2 eller luftfart samt relevante certificeringer
Er klar på at håndtere budgetter og kontrakter for dit eget område.

CPH som arbejdsplads

En arbejdsplads som ingen andre.

Københavns Lufthavne er en by i byen. Her arbejder tusindvis af mennesker på tværs af fagligheder og virksomheder for at holde lufthavnen i gang – døgnet rundt, året rundt. Hos os indgår du i et fællesskab, hvor der er et tæt samspil mellem drift og udvikling, og du bliver er en vigtig del af Danmarks største internationale infrastrukturelle knudepunkt.

Hvad vi tilbyder

I CPH gør vi os umage for at skabe gode rammer om din hverdag.

Du får adgang til medarbejdergoder, der både gør arbejdslivet lettere og giver balance i hverdagen. Det gælder blandt andet attraktive barselsvilkår (uanset køn), sundhedsforsikring for dig og din familie, pensionsordning, gratis parkering, gode transportmuligheder, samt træningsfaciliteter og adgang til sundhedscenter.

Samtidig bliver du en del af et mangfoldigt fællesskab med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling, sport, kultur og sociale aktiviteter.

Yderligere information

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet kan du sende en mail til CISO Christina Haustrup på christina.haustrup@cph.dk.

Du bedes uploade dit CV uden billede, med din motivation for at søge stillingen.

Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Ansøgningsfrist

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, som du bedes sende snarest muligt og senest den 13. november 2026. Vi læser løbende ansøgninger.

Vi skaber forbindelse til verden

CPH har i mere end 100 år forbundet mennesker og kulturer. Vi sender danskerne ud i verden og byder verden velkommen til Danmark. På tværs af CPH og i samarbejde med vores partnere udvikler vi fremtidens lufthavne. Sammen skaber vi ansvarlig vækst gennem sikker og stabil drift, digitalisering og gode passageroplevelser.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan blive politigodkendt og opretholde godkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse.

Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system

Who We Are Looking For

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Product Implementation Managers are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Commercial Product Implementation team, our Product Implementation Manager II leads the delivery of new products and enhancements to market, applying project management methodology to keep projects aligned with business strategy, on schedule, within budget, and in line with customer requirements. This role owns project quality and timeliness by developing estimates, plans, and milestones, tracking progress, and proactively managing risks, issues, scope, and resources across multiple concurrent projects – all in service of creating a person-focused health care experience.

Do you have a passion for serving others and learning new things? Do you thrive as part of a collaborative, caring team? Are you energized by managing multiple projects at once while delivering accurate, high-quality results on time? If so, this role may be the perfect fit.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:

5 years of experience managing large and complex projects.
At least one year of experience installing new insurance products and enhancements
Certificate in Project Management strongly preferred. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a strong plus

Skills And Attributes

Serves as a subject matter expert on new products and enhancements, with a thorough understanding of both the project life-cycle and product development lifecycle.
Drives deliverable dates and holds business areas and individuals accountable for meeting agreed-upon commitments.
Proven track record of moving complex projects through the organization, optimizing development time and processes, and meeting budget, timeline, and requirement targets while managing variances.
Leads multi-disciplinary, high-performance teams, with exceptionally strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate teams to achieve defined deliverables.
Identifies problems, mediates issues, and develops and implements solutions, including mitigating milestone and deliverable delays and critical resource allocation issues.
Skilled in identifying, assessing, and creating contingency plans for risk factors.
Strong oral and written communication and interpersonal skills with a customer service orientation, including experience presenting to all levels of management.
Partners with business sponsors, clients, and stakeholders to identify and implement solutions.
Mentors and develops project management skills in other project managers.
Functional competencies include Product Development Lifecycle, Budgeting, Change Management, Client Management, Methodology Approach and Business Life Cycle, Mission/Vision/Strategy, Project Planning and Organization, and Risk Management. Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making is highly desired.

What You Will Do At Cambia

Accountable for delivering projects to successful completion, including the quality and timeliness of all defined projects and the resolution of issues within them (goals, resource allocation, release planning, technology architecture, etc.).
Oversees multiple projects at once, ensuring timely deliverables within budgetary constraints.
Contributes to the development of company-adopted project management methods and ensures adherence to them.
Plans, directs, coordinates, and reports on project management activities in accordance with Enterprise Program Management Office policies and standards.
Manages the overall project plan(s), and prepares and presents plans and status reports to organizational leadership, project teams, and client/customer groups.
Drives project outcomes through effective planning, task definition, scope management, resource allocation and negotiation, risk mitigation, cost management, and stakeholder communication.
Assembles the project team, assigns responsibilities, identifies appropriate resources, and provides guidance and direction to team members.
Defines, collects, and analyzes metrics to keep projects on target, proactively recommends courses of action to maintain cost effectiveness, and ensures timely resolution of problems within the scope of the assignment.

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.

National pay structure — applies to the Boise and Lewiston, ID; Salt Lake City, UT, Oregon and Washington. The full salary range is $88,000 - $143,000 and the bonus target is 10%. The expected offer salary range is $93,500 - $126,500.

Regional pay structure — applies to North Dakota and Arkansas, as well as Idaho and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The full salary range is $79,000 - $129,000 and the bonus target is 10%. The expected offer salary range is $84,200 - $113,900.

About Cambia

Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.

Why Join the Cambia Team?

At Cambia, You Can

Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.

Benefits

In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:

Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
Commute and parking benefits.

Learn More About Our Benefits.

Celonis Services is a strategic services organization that focuses on the technical aspects of our customers' journeys, which includes Consulting Services, Academy and Customer Support. We are thought leaders with deep product, technical and domain expertise and focus on delivering Celonis implementations and driving product adoption for our customers. We achieve this by bringing together our best practices, delivery experience, award-winning enablement, and support expertise.

As a Lead Project Manager
, you will support end-to-end implementations of Celonis’ technology across our largest and most strategic customers. You will articulate Celonis’ product positioning to customers and collaborate with Sales, Partners and Value Engineering to establish Celonis’ Services Value proposition and create statements of work with customers during the pre-sales phase.

In this role, you will assist customers in understanding how to build best practice and enduring capabilities, are responsible for identifying further Services needs by the customer whilst engaged and responsible for customer satisfaction throughout a customer's engagement with Celonis.

The work you’ll do:

Lead complex transformational customer programs, shape and define the project outcome and then steer towards it.
Planning, scheduling, and management of project timelines and activities from project kick-off through to training, ensuring each project is delivered on time and meets the customers' requirements.
Manage resources, schedule, scope and budget on multiple projects by creating and maintaining detailed project plans that emphasize speed to delivery and maximise the efficient use of resources needed to meet the requirements.
Collaboration with senior executives, process owners and technical teams within each customer to understand their goals, objectives and requirements and to ensure their successful implementation. You will be their primary point of contact for product feature requests and escalation of support issues.
Regularly communicate project status, covering key discussion items, action items, risks and issues. Keep projects up to date in the Celonis Professional Services Automation System to enable accurate and timely project and portfolio reporting.
Proactively manage and escalate risks and issues internally to Celonis management and externally to customer project sponsors to minimize impact to project success.
Provide guidance and mentoring to the implementation team, including partner resources, to ensure Celonis methodology is being followed.
Use your experience to contribute to the continual improvement of Celonis Services methods as well as the maturing field expertise and best practices.

8-10 years client-facing Project Management experience in enterprise software implementations, managing multiple projects concurrently.
Extensive experience in project management disciplines, including documenting and maintaining project plans, risk/issue/action logs, and driving problem resolution in partnership with customers and Celonis executives.
Strong communication skills and a background in consulting with a proven ability to manage stakeholders and project timelines.
Experience in people managing consulting teams both onshore and offshore.
Experience in positioning Services, writing proposals and “statement of works” within a complete ecosystem (customers and partners).
A history of working with an ecosystem of partners and managed co-delivery.
Ability to effectively set and manage customer expectations.
Strong analytical skills, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems.
Ability and willingness to be certified in Celonis products.
Project management certifications (PMP, Prince2, or Safe/Agile).
Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or other related field.

$162,000—$191,000 USD

$150,000 - $240,000

Full-time / Onsite (5 days/week) / ~25-30% Travel

As Pallet scales into larger, more complex enterprise and mid-market customers, deployments become higher-stakes: more stakeholders, evolving requirements, real change management, and real consequences if things break.

Why This Role Is Different

You won't inherit a playbook, you'll help build it. This role owns enterprise deployments end-to-end, translating messy real-world operations into live AI agent workflows. You'll work directly with executives, shape how CoPallet scales, and play a defining role in how customers come to trust AI in mission-critical systems.

How You'll Make an Impact

Serve as the executive point of contact for customer deployments and long-term success

Translate complex business processes into executable AI agent workflows
Partner with Agent Delivery Engineers to validate assumptions and execute technically

Executives feel informed, confident, and trust Pallet as a long-term partner
Internal teams are aligned, accountable, and coordinated around customer outcomes
Deployment processes become more repeatable and scalable without sacrificing quality

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Job Summary

We are recruiting all-source intelligence analysts at the Higher Executive Officer (HEO) grade to work in the new National Security Intelligence Assessment (NSIA) unit in UKHSA’s Analysis and Intelligence Assessment (AIA) Directorate. We expertly fuse all sources of qualitative and quantitative information on UK and global health security threats and their drivers.

We provide insight and foresight to support Ministers, Chief Medical Officers (CMO), and policy and decision makers across Health and HMG; making impact every day.

This is an exciting time to join a growing UKHSA all-source assessment cadre, where you will join a fast-paced environment working across a variety of topic areas and continual opportunities for collaboration and improvement.

Working for your organisation

We pride ourselves as being an employer of choice, where Everyone Matters promoting equality of opportunity to actively encourage applications from everyone, including groups currently underrepresented in our workforce.  

UKHSA ethos is to be an inclusive organisation for all our staff and stakeholders. To create, nurture and sustain an inclusive culture, where differences drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our workforce and wider communities. We do this through celebrating and protecting differences by removing barriers and promoting equity and equality of opportunity for all.  

Please visit our careers site for more information https://gov.uk/ukhsa/careers

Job Description

In NSIA we deliver expert evidence synthesis, analysis and assessment of medical, epidemiological, environmental, bio-scientific and other information related to human health from all sources – open, technical and closed.
We employ critical thinking and structured analytical techniques, including futures projection, to draw out ‘so-what’ implications. We draw on world-leading talent across a range of disciplines, including intelligence assessment, epidemiology, data science, statistical modelling and social research, to maximise impact through collaboration.
We deliver assessments that provide insight and foresight to policy and decision-makers in UKHSA, DHSC, and across UK Government, supporting them to understand, prepare for, and mitigate health risks to the UK and its global interests.
As an analyst in this area, you will produce and support the production of all source intelligence assessment on a wide variety of UK and global health security topics, including international outbreaks and major events; health systems; health mis- and disinformation; chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN); medical supply resilience; and health technology. If not already, you will complete extensive training to join the Professional Head of Intelligence Assessment (PHIA) profession.
The post offers superb development opportunities and the chance to gain exposure across a broad range of policy areas, achieving real-world impact with the most senior officials at the heart of decision making in government.
We want to know what you can bring to the mission. In turn we will help you to broaden and deepen your expertise while in post, with a tailored learning and development offering within a supportive and positive working environment.

Main duties of the job

As a National Security Intelligence Analyst You Will:

Conduct intelligence analysis using structured analytic techniques to contribute to high-quality assessment products that provide UK decision-makers and policymakers with insight into a broad range of health security issues and their implications for the UK.
Support the development of analytical products by researching, collating, evaluating and interpreting information from a wide range of sources, including complex and potentially conflicting information.
Work closely with colleagues across AIA, UKHSA and wider government to support collaborative analytical projects and contribute to building effective working relationships with internal and external partners.
Maintain an awareness of emerging health security and national security developments within the UK and internationally, identifying issues of potential relevance to UK interests.
Communicate analytical findings clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, tailoring outputs appropriately for different audiences and clearly articulating levels of confidence and uncertainty.
Manage your workload effectively, delivering multiple tasks to agreed deadlines and escalating risks or challenges where appropriate.
Contribute to a positive team culture, supporting colleagues, sharing knowledge and continuously developing your analytical skills and subject matter expertise.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Threat Intelligence team protects the lululemon community, and the value & reputation of lululemon’s brand from adversarial threats through the pillars of intelligence; partnerships; and tradecraft. This is accomplished by connecting the cyber threat landscape to our business interests, generating timely and actionable intelligence, and cultivating relationships to mitigate those risks. To further enhance our team, we are looking for a Security Analyst on our Threat Intelligence.

Core Responsibilities

The Security Analyst – Threat Intelligence will work across the intelligence lifecycle to identify, assess, and communicate cyber threats relevant to lululemon, translating intelligence into actionable insights that strengthen our security posture.

Partner with stakeholders across lululemon to understand their intelligence needs and translate them into clear intelligence requirements and collection priorities.
Collect and analyze intelligence from open sources, security partners, vendors, and internal data to identify threats relevant to lululemon and the retail sector.
Research threat actors, campaigns, malware, infrastructure, indicators of compromise (IOCs), and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with a focus on cybercriminal and ransomware activity.
Produce clear, actionable intelligence for technical and non-technical audiences, including tactical reporting, threat notifications, and assessments of emerging threats and trends.
Partner closely with Security Operations (SOC) and Incident Response (IR) teams during investigations, using intelligence to identify threat actors, infrastructure, IOCs, and TTPs and inform response actions.
Leverage SIEM, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, and other security technologies to investigate adversary activity and translate intelligence into threat hunting, detection, and defensive opportunities.
Research and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs) from security leadership and other stakeholders, providing assessments that support informed decision-making.
Help mature lululemon's Threat Intelligence capability by developing processes, playbooks, knowledge management, collection strategies, and automation while identifying opportunities to improve how intelligence is operationalized across the organization.

Qualifications

2–4 years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, or a related cybersecurity discipline.
Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to turn technical information into clear, actionable intelligence.
Understanding of threat intelligence concepts and methodologies, including the intelligence lifecycle, IOCs, TTPs, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

Job Description

What You Will Be Doing

Hitachi Vantara is looking for a Data Analyst to join its Global Analytics & Decision Sciences (GADS) team. This is an entry-level opportunity designed for a recent undergraduate graduate or someone beginning a career in data, analytics, business intelligence, or decision sciences. The position follows a hybrid work model based in Norman, Oklahoma.

As a Data Analyst, you will work with experienced analysts, business intelligence professionals, data scientists, and stakeholders. You will help explore business questions, prepare and analyze data, develop reports and visualizations, and communicate findings in a clear and meaningful way.

You will gain exposure to how analytics supports multiple areas of the business, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, Product Management, Finance, and Pricing. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning innovative technologies, working with data, and understanding how analytical work can improve business decisions and processes.

Key Responsibilities And Expectations

Work with business stakeholders and team members to understand business questions, document requirements, and clarify the intended outcome of an analysis or reporting request.
Gather, organize, clean, and validate data from multiple sources in preparation for analysis and reporting.
Use tools such as SQL, Python, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and approved AI tools to explore data, perform analysis, automate routine work, and develop reports or visualizations.
Support the development and maintenance of Power BI dashboards, reports, datasets, and supporting documentation.
Perform exploratory and descriptive analysis to identify trends, patterns, outliers, and areas for further investigation.
Assist with defining, calculating, and validating business metrics and key performance indicators.
Conduct data-quality checks and help identify inconsistencies, missing information, or unexpected results.
Communicate analytical findings through clear visualizations, concise written summaries, and presentations appropriate for business audiences.
Support testing and validation of reports, analytical solutions, data transformations, and enhancements before release.
Partner with experienced team members on analytics, business intelligence, data science, and process improvement projects.
Document analytical methods, data sources, business definitions, assumptions, and recurring processes to support consistency and knowledge sharing.
Participate in team reviews, training, and working sessions while developing an understanding of the organization’s data, processes, and analytical standards.
Explore new analytical tools, techniques, and technologies and share relevant learnings with the team.
Manage assigned tasks responsibly, communicate progress and potential issues, and incorporate feedback into the work.

Required Qualifications

What You Bring to the Team

A recently completed or soon-to-be-completed bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or another quantitatively oriented field.
Foundational experience using SQL to retrieve, combine, or analyze data through academic coursework, internships, research, employment, or personal projects.
Foundational experience with at least one analytical programming language, preferably Python or R.
Familiarity with data visualization or business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including organizing, analyzing, and summarizing data.
Basic understanding of analytical and AI concepts such as descriptive statistics, data validation, regression, classification, prompt design, model limitations, or responsible AI use.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with an interest in understanding both the data and the business question behind it.
Attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, consistent, and well-documented work.
Ability to communicate clearly, ask thoughtful questions, and explain findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Ability to work collaboratively with individuals from different functions, backgrounds, and levels of technical experience.
Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn unfamiliar business concepts, data sources, and technologies.
Ability to organize assigned work, balance multiple priorities, and respond constructively to feedback.

Experience Expectations

Prior full-time professional analytics experience is not required. Relevant experience may come from:

Internships or cooperative education assignments
Undergraduate research or capstone projects
Technical coursework or laboratory work
Student organizations, analytics competitions, or hackathons
Volunteer analytics projects
Independent technical projects
Part-time employment involving data, reporting, or process improvement

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are helpful but are not required:

Experience developing reports or dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or a similar visualization tool.
Exposure to data preparation, data modeling, dimensional modeling, or ETL concepts.
Experience using Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or similar analytical libraries.
Familiarity with relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, or version-control tools such as Git.
Exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, generative AI, or other emerging analytical technologies through coursework or projects.
Experience presenting an analysis, technical project, or recommendation to a classroom, project team, student organization, or business audience.
A portfolio, GitHub repository, capstone project, or other work sample demonstrating analytical thinking and technical curiosity.
Experience collaborating on a team-based technical, academic, or business project.

What Success Looks Like

Learn about the team’s primary business areas, data sources, reporting standards, and development practices.
Complete assigned analysis and reporting tasks with appropriate guidance.
Demonstrate consistent attention to data quality and business definitions.
Ask questions early when requirements, data, or expected outcomes are unclear.
Clearly document work so that analyses and reports can be reviewed and maintained.
Apply feedback and show measurable growth in technical skills, business understanding, communication, and the responsible use of AI to improve work quality and efficiency.
Progress from supporting defined analytical tasks toward independently completing smaller analyses, report enhancements, and stakeholder deliverables.

jobs.title: Research Analyst for Extended Producer Responsibilities (EPR) for Packaging
jobs.description:
Consultant as Research Analyst for Extended Producer Responsibilities (EPR) for Packaging - Ocean and Plastic Waste Program

This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position
.

Program Overview

World Resources Institute (WRI) Indonesia is an independent, nonprofit research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. WRI Indonesia works with government, businesses, civil society, research institutions, and development partners to advance evidence-based policies and solutions for sustainable development.

Through its work on plastic pollution and the circular economy, WRI Indonesia supports Indonesia and relevant stakeholders in strengthening policies, institutions, and implementation mechanisms to reduce plastic pollution and promote a more inclusive and sustainable packaging system. Mandatory Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) is an important policy instrument for strengthening producers' responsibility for the post-consumer management of packaging. Effective implementation requires an enabling ecosystem that connects packaging design, recycled-content markets, alternative materials, reuse and refill systems, financing mechanisms, waste management infrastructure, and inclusive participation across the value chain.

Job Highlight

Role

The Research Analyst will support the delivery of a research package to strengthen mandatory Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) for packaging in Indonesia. The role will contribute to data collection, analysis, and drafting across three interconnected research workstreams:

Sustainable packaging ecosystem and governance: Assessment of recycled-content markets, alternative packaging materials, and reuse/refill systems, including recommendations for policy interventions, implementation roadmaps, and traceability frameworks.
Strengthening mandatory EPR for packaging: Assessment of policy scenarios and their implications for EPR costs, contributions from non-obliged companies, greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and eco-modulation mechanisms.
Equity and just transition: Analysis of formal and informal sector value chains, socioeconomic and employment impacts, social protection, and gender equality, disability, and social inclusion (GEDSI), with recommendations for an inclusive transition (including GEDSI guideline for EPR implementation).

What You Will Do

Research, Data Analysis, and Writing (75%)

Conduct literature reviews, policy and regulatory analysis on EPR for packaging, recycled-content policies, eco-modulation, traceability, reuse/refill, and just transition.
Collect, clean, and manage primary and secondary data on packaging placed on the market, waste generation, collection and recycling rates, recycled-resin prices and offtake, and waste management costs. Maintain a clear log of data sources, assumptions, and limitations.
Develop and run spreadsheet-based models and scenario calculations for EPR costs, recycled-content targets, and GHG emissions (e.g., material flow analysis, emission factors, cost-per-tonne estimates) under the direction of the Managers and Senior Research Lead.
Map packaging and recycling value chains, including producers, producer responsibility organizations, recyclers, aggregators (lapak/pelapak), waste banks (bank sampah), and informal waste workers.
Support the design and test data collection tools (e.g. interview guides, survey questionnaires, FGD protocols), and conduct interviews, field visits, and focus group discussions, collecting sex- and disability-disaggregated data where relevant.
Analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and develop tables, charts, maps, and infographics to communicate findings clearly.
Draft assigned sections, annexes, and summaries for three technical knowledge products, incorporating feedback from Senior Research Lead, peer reviewers, and donor representative.

Stakeholder Engagement, Coordination, and Administrative Support (25%)

Coordinate logistic for technical consultations, interviews, workshops, and validation meetings with government ministries and agencies, private sector representatives, producer responsibility organizations, industry associations, recyclers, civil society organizations, research institutions, and informal sector representatives.
Prepare background notes, meeting materials, and presentations, and documenting consultation findings and agreed follow-up actions.
Maintain organized stakeholder contact list, consultation records, and research files in accordance with WRI’s data management and research ethics procedures.
Support the preparation of policy briefs, slide decks, blogs, and other short products that share research findings with government, donors, and the public.
Support work planning, progress tracking, and donor reporting for the research package.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, economics, public policy, development studies, sustainability, social sciences, or other relevant field.
Minimum 4 (four) years of relevant professional experience in applied research, policy analysis, circular economy, waste management, sustainable packaging, or related fields.
Sound understanding of EPR, plastic pollution, recycling markets, and circular economy concepts, as well as Indonesia's waste management, packaging, and environmental policy landscape.
Demonstrate strong quantitative research skills, including data cleaning, analysis, and spreadsheet modelling in Excel. Experience with R, Python, Stata, or similar tools is an advantage.
Experience or training in at least one of the following areas: material flow analysis, cost analysis, GHG accounting, or life-cycle assessment.
Experience conducting qualitative research, including interviews, focus group discussions, and fieldwork, ideally with informal sector workers or communities.
Demonstrate understanding of gender equality, disability, and social inclusion (GEDSI) and how to incorporate these considerations into research design, data collection, and analysis.
Demonstrate strong research writing skills, with experience contributing to technical reports, policy briefs, or other research publications.
Demonstrate the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-specialist audiences using written and visual formats
Well organised, pay close attention to detail, and able to maintain multiple competing priorities.
Work well in a team and be comfortable engaging with government, private sector, civil society, and community stakeholders.
Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English on both verbal and written communications
Ability and willingness to travel as required
Legally able to work in Indonesia

Duration

1 December 2026 – 31 December 2027

Deliverables

The Research Analyst will contribute to the timely, high-quality delivery of the three technical knowledge products below, working under the technical lead of the Senior Research Lead.

Deliverable 1: Draft of Technical Report on Building the Ecosystem and Governance for Sustainable Packaging

The Report Will Assess And Recommend Ways To Build a Sustainable Packaging Ecosystem In Indonesia, Covering Demand For Recycled Content, Recycled-content Targets, Traceability, And Ecomodulation Framework. The Research Analyst Will Support It By

Supporting research and analysis on recycled content target-setting and scenario, traceability, and ecomodulation frameworks.
General support in data collection and research writing
Deliverable 2: Draft of Technical Paper on Strengthening Mandatory EPR for Packaging.

The Paper Will Assess Policy Scenarios For Mandatory EPR And Their Effects On System Costs, Contributions From Non-obliged Companies, GHG Emissions, And Eco-modulation. The Research Analyst Will Support It By

Supporting EPR for packaging research through cost data collection and scenario analysis, profiling non-obliged companies and developing their contribution mechanisms, assessing GHG impacts and alignment with national and corporate climate targets.
Deliverable 3: Draft of Technical Paper on Equity and Just Transition in Mandatory EPR for Packaging

The Paper Will Set Out a Pathway Toward a Just And Inclusive EPR System, Including GEDSI Guidelines. The Research Analyst Will Support It By

Supporting interviews and focus group discussions with various stakeholders

For all deliverables, the Research Analyst will also provide the following supporting outputs:

A shared, well-organised evidence base: literature review matrix, datasets, and model files with a documented assumptions log.
Interview, consultation, and validation notes in an agreed format.
Charts, tables, infographics, and slide decks for presentations and dissemination.
Short monthly progress updates to the Research Lead.

Terms of Payment

Daily rate-based consultant with a maximum of 20 (twenty) working days per month

How To Apply

Please submit a resume with a cover letter by 12 November 2026. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates.
Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position.
Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed.
This is a locally engaged position, Indonesian nationals are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer

Consultant rate that is commensurate with experience and skill.
Travel insurance for both domestic and international for any travel duty as assigned by WRI Indonesia
Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields.
A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work
The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI
Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours

About Us

World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.

Our Mission And Values

WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations.

Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership, and Care.

Our Culture

WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Our Human Resources Team carefully reviews all applications.

Job Description

Business Unit Overview

As a top 10 North American bank, TD aims to stand out from its peers by having a differentiated brand. Anchored in our proven business model and rooted in a desire to give our customers, communities, and colleagues the confidence to thrive in a changing world. The TD Framework embodies our culture and guides our behavior as we execute on our business strategy of being a premier Canadian retail bank, a top U.S. retail bank, and a leading Wholesale business aligned with our retail franchise.

Department Overview

Global Business Services & Operations is at the core of TD Securities. We are a dynamic, multi-faceted division that partners with all parts of the Dealer, including Sales & Trading to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients globally. Global Business Services & Operations recruits highly motivated individuals who can help the Dealer and our clients facilitate business. Professionals in Global Business Services & Operations come from a variety of academic and professional backgrounds.

The successful candidate will be part of the Client Due Diligence team within Global Business Services & Operations. The Client Due Diligence team is committed to ensuring services provided across the Bank and to its clients are delivered in a professional manner, that risk is minimized, and the client has a positive experience. The candidate is expected to think creatively, improve the daily process, and take responsibility and ownership for this to happen.

Team Overview

The Client Due Diligence (CDD) team conducts due diligence on TD Securities clients during onboarding, periodic reviews, and on an ongoing basis. The team ensures compliance with Global AML, specifically under Canada and U.S. regulatory requirements, mitigating operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.

Job Description/Accountabilities

Lead departmental projects: Drive process improvements, system enhancements, and risk mitigation initiatives for CDD operations.
Oversee the team's workload: Ensure requests are managed in a timely manner and escalate issues as needed to maintain compliance and efficiency.
Manage work queues for onboarding and ensure adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) while maintaining quality standards.
Assist with onboarding requests: Continue to work on client onboarding, periodic reviews, and ad-hoc requests, ensuring compliance with KYC, FATCA, CIRO, and AML requirements.
Mentor and train new team members, providing guidance on AML requirements and promoting adherence to regulatory standards.
Handle complex cases: Perform secondary reviews of AML analysis, ensuring thoroughness, accuracy, and proper risk assessment.
Manage escalations: Address complex or high-priority cases by working with business partners and ensuring the team adheres to SLAs.
Lead audit and regulatory exam preparation: Coordinate efforts for audits by collecting, analyzing, and presenting required data.
Support strategic initiatives: Participate in the rollout and development of new processes, systems, and operational enhancements across the department.
Identify areas of concern: Work closely with the manager to identify and address areas of concern, whether from a KYC perspective or any other challenges the department is facing.
Drive adherence to AML standards: Ensure all team members understand and comply with AML regulations, including KYC, FATCA, CIRO, and CRS.
Participate in the rollout and adoption of new operational and regulatory initiatives within the team.
Handle competing priorities: Be willing and able to juggle multiple tasks with competing deadlines and priorities while ensuring a high level of performance.

Job Requirements

Advanced knowledge of AML regulations, including PCMLTFA, FATCA, CIRO, and broader AML trends.
Leadership skills: Ability to lead and mentor a team, guide junior members, and manage escalations effectively.
Project management experience: Capable of managing or contributing to projects focused on process improvement, system enhancements, or regulatory compliance.
Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking: Ability to handle complex tasks with competing priorities while ensuring consistent delivery.
Proficiency with data analysis tools, including Excel, Bloomberg, Impact, UI Path, Alteryx, and VBA is preferred.
Exceptional communication skills, able to influence team members and business partners.
CAMS designation is an asset.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

The team ensures compliance with Global AML, specifically under Canada and U.S. regulatory requirements, mitigating operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.
