Conduct AML reviews: Collect and verify Canada and U.S. AML requirements (e.g. KYC, CIP, FATCA, CIRO, CRS), ensuring compliance during onboarding, periodic reviews, and ad-hoc events.
Conduct in-depth research using independent online sources to gather requisite information for client due diligence.
Liaise with business partners: Respond to regulatory inquiries and escalate issues as needed to ensure compliance.
Maintain audit trails: Ensure accurate tracking of incoming requests and documentation throughout the process.
Assist in regulatory audits by gathering relevant data for auditors and internal control teams.
Deliver exceptional quality: Perform accurate data entry, mitigating risks related to regulatory, financial, operational, or reputational exposure.
Identify opportunities for improvement: Engage in process enhancement initiatives to improve efficiency.
Assist with strategic initiatives and participate in the rollout and adoption of new operational and regulatory initiatives.

Job Requirements

Knowledge of AML regulations including PCMLTFA, FATCA, CIRO, BSA, etc., as well as a strong understanding of the TD Securities business environment.
Ability to work on routine and ad-hoc requests within defined parameters, while handling operational and reporting functions.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills to meet deadlines in a high-volume environment.
Excellent communication skills: Ability to collaborate effectively with team members and business partners.
Proficiency with MS Office tools, particularly Word, Excel and Powerpoint. Technical skills in UI Path, Alteryx, VBA are a plus.
CAMS designation is an asset.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

jobs.title: Population Health and VBC Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Population Health and Value-Based Care Manager is responsible for developing and implementing strategies to optimize health outcomes for diverse populations served by Adelante Healthcare. This role includes overseeing population health initiatives, managing value-based care programs, and ensuring compliance with relevant healthcare regulations. This position will be responsible for coordinating with the patient care teams and operational management as well as monitoring and driving the program's financial performance. The incumbent of this position must understand the balance between finances and patient care and be capable of prioritizing accordingly. Additionally, the manager will cultivate partnerships with health plans to support value-based care models.

EXPECTATIONS

Every Adelante Healthcare leader will strive to maximize the performance and contribution of each team member of Adelante Healthcare and the community that we serve every day. Leaders are expected to set clear performance expectations, establish specific measurable goals for team members to drive accountability and success, provide ongoing feedback and coaching to enhance performance, improve results and outcomes. Leaders are also expected to work in a manner that demonstrates a commitment to our mission, vision, core values quality, patient safety, employee engagement, innovation, and model for all other employees the highest standards of personal integrity, professionalism, and competence.

OUR CORE VALUES

Inclusion
Nurture
Service
Purposeful
Integrity
Resilient
Engaged

Qualifications

ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

An associate’s degree in applied sciences or equivalent
Minimum of three (3) years of experience in population health management, value-based care, or healthcare administration, ideally within an FQHC or similar setting.
High level of experience with HEDIS, UDS, AZARA, network portals, Care Gaps closure, Data analysis, attestation forms, and performance improvement.
In-depth understanding of population health principles, value-based care models, and quality improvement processes.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and healthcare data management systems.
Proven ability to build partnerships with health plans and understand value-based care agreements.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
Proficient in healthcare quality improvement methodologies and community health assessment frameworks.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external customers.
Valid Level One Fingerprint Clearance Card issued by the Arizona Department of Public Safety.
Certification to perform cardiopulmonary Resuscitation for the Health Care Professional (CPR) and AED through courses that follow the guidelines from the American Heart Association and Red Cross (cognitive and skills evaluations).
Valid Arizona Driver’s License
Travel to all health centers if required.

Position Reponsibilities/Essential

Compliance with Regulatory Standards:

Collaborate with Provider Network Manager to ensure Adherence with Networks contracted with Adelante.
Ensure Adherence with The National Committee for Quality Assurance to improve the quality of healthcare.
Ensure adherence to HRSA (Health Resources and Services Administration) guidelines related to population health and value-based care initiatives.
Implement and maintain practices that comply with Arizona Department of Health regulations and Joint Commission standards.
Ensure Population Health & Health Centers working on VBC conduct regular evaluations and audits to verify compliance, identify areas for improvement, and document progress on quality initiatives.

Education And Training

Schedule training for health centers’ key stakeholders to ensure proper use of codes and closure of care gaps.
Provide training and support to staff on population health management practices, value-based care principles, and relevant data analysis tools.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions aimed at enhancing organizational understanding of population health initiatives and their impact on patient care.

Collaborative Efforts

Foster strong relationships with healthcare providers, community organizations, health plans, and stakeholders to promote integrated healthcare solutions.
Participate in community health initiatives aimed at improving access to care, addressing social determinants of health, and enhancing community well-being.

POPULATION HEALTH PROGRAM

Develop, implement, and monitor population health management strategies that address specific health needs within the community, particularly for high-risk and underserved populations.
Conduct data analysis to identify health disparities and target interventions for specific populations aimed at improving health outcomes and access to care.
Design and implement programs to promote preventive care, chronic disease management, and early intervention strategies.
Collaborate with healthcare providers and community organizations to align resources and services to support population health initiatives.
Pull data of metrics and benchmarks to evaluate the effectiveness of population health programs, adjust strategies based on performance data, and report outcomes to stakeholders.
Compile and report outcomes to stakeholders, including success of initiatives, provide insights into program adjustments, and illustrate the impact on community health.

VBC PROGRAM

Financial Tracking And Analysis

Collaborate with the Senior Manager of Nursing Department and Medical Areas or Operations Manager to develop and manage financial models to assess the financial viability of value-based care initiatives and track the financial performance of each plan.
Partner with Operational Value Based Care teammates to optimize efforts for closing care gaps in Medicaid, Medicare, and Commercial patient populations, in that order of priority.
Partner with Data Analytics department, IT, Clinical and Operational Leadership to maintain accurate patient rosters for the value-based care programs.
Collect and communicate Value-Based Care quality results and strategies as needed to Senior Manager of Nursing Department and Quality Improvement.
Prepare and manage budgets for value-based care programs and monitor adherence to financial targets.
Develop key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the financial performance of value-based care programs and partner with operational leadership to achieve results.
Collaborate with and Provider Network Manager to Identify financial risks associated with value-based care contracts and develop strategies to mitigate them.
Work to maximize revenue through effective care coordination, patient engagement, and quality improvement initiatives in coordination with Operational and Clinical Management.
Utilize data analytics and partner with the Data Analytics Team to assess the financial performance of value-based care programs and identify areas for improvement.
Educate staff and healthcare providers about the financial aspects of value-based care and how their actions can impact financial outcomes.
Prepare reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices in value-based care and healthcare finance.
Collaborate with the provider network manager to Implement a clear and rigorous system for segregating VBC payments from the regular FQHC PPS prospective payments. This can involve creating separate accounts or financial codes to track VBC income separately.
Stay up to date with federal and state regulations of FQHC funding and reporting requirements, ensuring that VBC payments do not compromise the FQHC's compliance and remain separate from PPS.
Collaborate with the provider network manager to generate detailed financial reports that clearly distinguish VBC payments from prospective payments to maintain transparency in financial reporting.
Collaborate with the Provider Network Manager, CSML in the review process of VBC contracts to understand the terms, conditions, and performance measures associated with these agreements. Ensure that any financial incentives align with the FQHC's mission and goals.

Accountable Care Organization Tracking & Analysis

Collaborate with the Provider Network Manager to build a robust, well-documented system for managing all standard ACO operations, including CMS-mandated reporting, patient and provider communications, payments of claims, and maintenance of compliance.
Collaborated with Nursing Department and operations to align and collect KPIs data; determine insights and performance-improving actions items based on analysis and tracking of indicator reporting.
Determine how best to use data and analytics to inform effective strategic decision-making around ACO operations.
Other projects as requested by the Senior Manager of Nursing Department and Quality Improvement.

VBC HEALTH PLANS AUDIT PROGRAM

Ensure timely execution of audit requests by developing and implementing a robust, well-documented system for responding to health plan audits.
Develop improvement plans, if necessary, based on internal tracers, identifying trends, and identifying problematic areas.
Responsible for overseeing Adelante Healthcare's Health Plans Audit Program.

Nonessential Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Additional Duties And Responsibilities

Other duties as requested or assigned.

Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) and Integrated Care Team (ICT)

All employees are responsible for promoting and participating in interdisciplinary communication and collaboration to enhance the delivery of quality across the health care system. Employees should maintain an environment which supports and engages patients and co-workers in a caring team-based model to promote wellness and improve health outcomes.

Adherence to Compliance and Code of Conduct

All employees are required to comply with Adelante Healthcare’s written standards, including its Compliance Program and Code of Conduct, policies and procedures and reporting of any conduct that potentially violates Adelante’s legal or compliance requirements. Such compliance will be an element considered as part of the regular performance evaluation.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be required to sit for long periods of time, is required to stand, walk, use hands to handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb steps/stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; smell; manage stress as it relates to essential job functions. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds without assistance and may occasionally be required to lift or move up to 50 pounds with assistance. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work environment:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to weather conditions prevalent at the time when traveling to various clinic sites. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The employee may be subject to health hazards (contagious diseases, blood borne pathogens, etc.) when working in the clinic area.

If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As a Payments Operations Analyst, you'll be part of the Payments team within Claims Operations, reporting to the Payments Operations lead. You'll help run and improve the operations that move money to our members every week, working directly with the partners who receive it. Your work will directly shape the member experience as Garner grows and launches new ways to reward members for choosing great care.

What you will do

Run day-to-day payment operations, including weekly payment cycles, funding, and the checks and controls that keep member payments accurate and on time
Serve as a point of contact for external payment partners, working through file delivery, funding, error reports, and issue resolution
Investigate payment issues end to end: analyze error reports, find the root cause, and drive fixes with internal teams and partners

Role Overview

The Treasury team is part of Circana’s global Finance and Strategy organization and manages a broad range of operational and strategic activities, including cash management, banking, liquidity planning, capital structure, and financial risk management. The team supports approximately 25 countries and partners closely with Controllership, Tax, Legal, and Financial Planning & Analysis.

As the OUS Treasury Operations Analyst, you will serve as the primary resource for daily Treasury Operations outside the United States. You will independently manage core cash processes, including daily cash positioning, Treasury transactions, forecasting, reporting, banking administration, and operational controls across a complex international environment.

You will review and interpret cash activity, identify liquidity or operational concerns, and recommend improvements to cash visibility, forecast accuracy, processes, and controls. The role requires close partnership with the OUS Treasury Operations Manager, local Controllers, global banking partners, and teams across Controllership, Tax, Legal, and FP&A.

This role reports to the OUS Treasury Operations Manager and supports Treasury activities across approximately 25 countries. The OUS and US Analysts will cross-train and provide backup coverage for one another.

Job Responsibilities

Prepare and review daily OUS cash positioning, analyzing cash movements and identifying liquidity risks, funding needs, or unusual activity requiring escalation.
Execute Treasury transactions, including wires, ACH payments, and intercompany transfers, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to authorization and control requirements.
Own key components of daily, weekly, and monthly cash forecasting, including gathering and validating inputs, analyzing variances, and recommending improvements to forecast reliability.
Monitor cash across countries, currencies, legal entities, and banking platforms to support liquidity decisions and timely funding.
Partner with local Controllers, banks, Tax, Legal, Controllership, and FP&A to resolve cash-related issues and support international Treasury activities.
Review daily bank activity and partner with Controllership and local Finance teams to investigate and resolve cash or reconciliation exceptions.
Maintain bank account and authorized-signer documentation and support account openings, closures, and administrative updates across international banking partners.
Administer user access and entitlements within online banking platforms and Treasury systems in accordance with security and control requirements.
Monitor intercompany loan balances and maintain supporting schedules, ensuring accurate records and visibility into internal funding activity.
Prepare and enhance Treasury reporting, providing clear insights into cash trends, forecast variances, liquidity needs, and operational drivers.
Identify risks or issues within international Treasury processes and determine the appropriate stakeholders and escalation path.
Identify and support practical improvements to Treasury processes, controls, workflows, data quality, and operational efficiency.
Support Treasury systems and automation initiatives, including testing, documentation, and implementation of system enhancements.
Support audit, compliance, and documentation requirements, ensuring adherence to internal policies and control standards.
Participate in Treasury projects, cross-training, and process documentation initiatives.

About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution and completion of projects considering budget, timelines, resources and task management. The Project Manager will communicate in a transparent and timely manner with the assigned Signant Health clients and internal stakeholders. He/she will manage project risks and ensure timely resolution while reporting out on project status with the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.

The Project Manager contributes to the implementation of company-wide process improvements to ensure effective and efficient project delivery.

This role requires an effective leader that excels in problem-solving, able to motivate a result-oriented team, and can build trust-based relationships with Signant Health’s clients.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

Manage and lead the initial project delivery tasks, including, but not limited to the software development lifecycle (SDLC) of Simple to Medium complexity studies.

Manage projects in accordance with established timelines, budget, quality standards, and/or contractual requirements.
Review, approve and maintain project and corporate systems and documentation.

Accountable for financial health of the assigned projects. This can include vendor services, licensing, payments, invoicing, devices, resource assignments and vendor management activities.
Collaborate with other functional areas for project delivery to ensure timelines and client expectations are met within budget.
Responsible for identification and documentation of Incident Reports with Quality Management group. (Inclusive of Client Notification and Closure)
Responsible for reporting of project status updates.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Role

As a Project Manager, the employee is expected to recognize the importance of and to create a culture of process improvement with a focus on streamlining our processes adding value to our business and meeting client needs.
As a member of staff, the employee is expected to embrace and contribute to our culture of process improvement with a focus on streamlining our processes adding value to our business and meeting client needs.
Responsible for compliance with Company Procedures in support of client deliverables.
Recognize, exemplify and adherence to the company values which centre around our commitment to People, Clients, and performance.

DECISION MAKING AND INFLUENCE

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence.
Capable of weighing risks and making decisions that align with Signant values and strategy.
Manage customer escalations effectively, with follow up and closure.

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential:

Bachelors’ degree or equivalent or relevant experience
Understanding of the software development life cycle and the specification and configuration of software products
Able to multi-task and work with multiple team members
Must have excellent time management, communication (oral and written), and organizational skills
Must be detail, and first-time quality delivery, orientated
Must have solid MS Office Suite experience – Word, Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint
Ability and experience of direct project activities and ensuring customer satisfaction while understanding and adhering to the study budget
Must be comfortable speaking in front of diversified and/or large audiences
Must be able to communicate and engage effectively with all levels of the organization and have excellent written and spoken English skills
Must have experience in a Project Management role OR equivalent
Must show initiative and be able to work independently as needed

Desirable:

Background in Pharmaceutical, Medical education and/or CRO
Experience of clinical trials/pharmaceutical industry/life sciences
Ability to travel for business trips (overnight business trips could be expected quarterly)
Experience/understanding of the clinical research environment and GCP principles is preferred
PMP or equivalent certificate.

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Assistant Commissioning Project Manager - Level III

Position Location:

Travel Requirements:

Job Summary

The Assistant Commissioning Project Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems.

The Assistant Commissioning Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project management team and interact closely with the Project manager and Program Manager, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

The role may assist with developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws, and specifications.

This person will collaborate with design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, client staff and the commissioning team to test, validate and make operational newly installed and operational electrical and mechanical systems including those in mission critical facilities.

The Assistant Commissioning Project Manager working with the team will execute commissioning and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Manage all Elements of Commissioning Projects (50%)

Assist with pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
Coordinate and support resource and material forecasting
Develop, manage and monitor schedule
Participate in, schedule or lead project meetings

Participate in factory witness testing and observe startup activities
Use technical equipment to perform testing
Direct vendors / contractors in the execution of the testing

Manage Stakeholder Relations (10%)

Assist in the preparation of proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
Assist in the promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
Maintain client relationships to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
Support contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
Ensure client satisfaction through active communication

Develop Testing Plans and Procedures for Complex Projects (5%)

Development of commissioning plans
Prepare pre-functional checklists
Prepare functional performance test scripts

Review Construction Related Design Documents, Drawings and Specifications (5%)

Review shop drawings and submittals
Review sequence of operations
Assist in commissioning focused design reviews

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices
Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, and coordination of people and resources
Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in the construction mission critical, commercial buildings, or other structures
Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
Skilled at managing personnel and material resources
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
Ability to learn client and / or industry specific management software
Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports, and correspondence
Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)

Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with onsite and remote team members
Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues
Proficient at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools

OR

PLUS

Who We Are

Founded in 1965, UC Irvine
is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

UCI's Department of Emergency Medicine is committed to advancing clinical care, education and research to help patients with diverse emergency conditions. The affiliated Center for Trauma & Injury Prevention Research (CTIPR) is committed to risk mitigation and the reduction of traumatic injury and addiction through multidisciplinary research; the translation of research into policy and practice and by working in close partnership with communities and serving as a regional and national resource.

Your Role on the Team

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Project Manager to lead a community-driven traffic safety initiative designed to harness local insights in identifying and mitigating emerging traffic hazards. The Project Manager will lead efforts to develop and implement a platform that enables local road users to report traffic hazards, focusing on proactive community engagement. The role will involve reaching out to community centers, colleges, high schools, libraries and other pertinent centers to invite people to submit their concerns and identify hazard points for pedestrians through our website. The Project Manager will monitor submissions and collaborate with a traffic safety expert or consultant to obtain technical reports on the identified hazard points. Additionally, they will work with Street Stories to ensure that reported points are accurately reflected. The Project Manager will also establish relationships with traffic safety authorities, scheduling and leading meetings to discuss the submitted reports and following up on any agreements made during these meetings. They will ensure ongoing communication with the community by providing updates and progress reports through the website. To expand the program's reach, the Project Manager will revisit key community locations and leverage social media to increase participation. They will track project progress, organize meetings, and prepare quarterly progress reports (QPR) and any other required documentation.

Required

new_jobs.description:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

We are the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco — public servants with a mission to advance the nation’s monetary, financial, and payment systems to build a stronger economy for all Americans. As part of the nation’s central bank, we are committed to understanding and serving the vibrant, expansive communities of the Twelfth District, which covers the nine western states of the U.S. That means we seek and appreciate new perspectives and build opportunities to learn and grow. At the SF Fed, we approach our work with integrity and a commitment to service.

The Supervision Group is responsible for the supervision and regulation of state member banks (SMBs), bank holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, financial holding companies, bank service providers, trust companies, and foreign banking organizations that are headquartered in the Twelfth District. Supervised institutions range in size and complexity from small community organizations to some of the largest banking organizations in the country.

We have an excellent opportunity for a Sr. Business Analyst
within Business Operations and Strategy. The Sr. Business Analyst will provide operational and administrative support to bank examination teams and develop MIS reporting and analysis to drive decisions on group operations, planning, and business issues. In addition, the Sr. Business Analyst will use business knowledge and analytical abilities to evaluate existing processes, provide recommendations on operational optimization and quality improvement initiatives, and lead the implementation of solutions, including automation and emerging technologies such as AI. This is a versatile role with responsibilities that will grow as process improvements take hold.

Our ideal candidate has extensive experience as a business analyst, strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You have deep experience gathering requirements, process mapping, and creating operational improvements, and you have used automation, dashboards, and emerging technology, including AI, to improve how work gets done. You communicate well in writing and in person, collaborate effectively across teams, and drive a culture of continuous quality improvement. You are adaptable and committed to team continuity.

Essential Responsibilities

Provide operational and administrative support throughout the exam life cycle, including formatting supervisory documents, document management, tracking results, and data entry and verification of exam content across multiple applications.
Collaborate cross-functionally to map current processes, identify key controls, roles, bottlenecks, and difficulties, and define and implement improved processes.
Streamline and automate manual work using Microsoft tools such as Power Automate and Power Apps.
Evaluate AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) for practical use cases, recommend where they add value, and help prepare the team for responsible adoption.
Gather business requirements, then design and build dashboards (Tableau or Power BI) and MIS reporting. Analyze data and metrics to uncover insights and trends.
Coordinate projects and activities to address business needs and monitor metrics to ensure project effectiveness.
Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of new technologies and processes, and assess the impact of upcoming technology and business changes on the team.
Design and deliver training and materials for internal and external partners.
Write, update, and maintain team procedures as the business changes, and contribute to the unit's internal procedures tool.
Strengthen team continuity through cross-training, documentation, and backup coverage, and mentor interns and team members.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Five or more years of experience in business requirements gathering, process mapping, process improvement, and/or analytics.
Strong proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel, Visio, and SQL, plus Power Apps or Power Automate.
Project coordination experience.
Experience building dashboards in Tableau or Power BI.
Experience collecting, transforming, analyzing, and reporting data to drive decisions.
Experience working cross-functionally and communicating moderate to complex information to broad audiences.
Ability to execute consistently amid changing priorities, and to handle confidential information.
Will and able to travel up to 5%.
This position requires access to confidential supervisory information, which is limited to “Protected Individuals.” Protected Individuals include, but are not limited to, U.S. citizens and U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents who are not yet eligible to apply for naturalization, and U.S. permanent residents who have applied for naturalization within six months of being eligible to do so or who will sign a declaration of intent to apply for naturalization before they begin employment.

Preferred

Financial institution supervision experience and knowledge of Federal Reserve System activities.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot or similar AI assistants.
Quality improvement training or certification (e.g., Lean Six Sigma).
Working knowledge of AI tools, or hands-on experience applying them to improve work processes.

Base Salary Range: Min: $103,000 Mid: $133,900 Max:$164,600 (Location: San Francisco)

Final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant’s background, experience, skills, internal equity, and alignment with geographic and other market data.

new_jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana Healthy Horizons is seeking a Medicaid Implementation Senior Project Manager to manage all aspects of a project, from start to finish, so that it is completed on time and within budget. The Medicaid Implementation Senior Project Manager work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. This role mainly focuses on the "Business" side of State Medicaid Implementations with very limited scope in the IT implementation activities. Individuals with business process change management and project management are best suited for this role.

The Medicaid Implementation Senior Project Manager Roles And Responsibilities

Plan, organize, monitor, and oversee complex projects utilizing cross functional teams to deliver defined requirements and meet company strategic objectives.
Assists in training and perform duties as the dedicated Project Manager.
Manages the full project life cycle, including review of various sources to assess requirements, creation of project plans and schedules, obtaining and managing resources, managing budget, and facilitating project execution, deployment, and closure.
Maintains detailed project documentation including meeting minutes, action items, issues lists, project plans, and risk management plans.
Provides leadership and effectively communicate project status to all stakeholders and external agencies.
Negotiates with project stakeholders to identify resources, resolve issues, and mitigate risks.
Coordinates cross-functional meetings with various functional areas to meet overall stakeholder expectations and company’s objectives.
Provides functional and technical knowledge across multiple business and technical areas.
Monitors the creation of all project deliverables to ensure adherence to quality standards including design documents, test plans, training materials, and operations documentation.
Provides on-site leadership for project team by building and motivating team members to meet project goals, adhering to their responsibilities and project milestones.
Works creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment demonstrating teamwork, innovation, and excellence.
Provides status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across leadership.
Understands interdependencies between technology, operations, and business needs.
Acts as an internal quality control check for the project and participates in quality issue resolution.
Defines the Statement of Work and Specifications for the requested Medicaid Contract/RFP.
Sets and continually manages project and program expectations while delegating and managing deliverable with team members and stakeholders.
Delivers appropriate and effective executive level communication.
Ensures that projects and programs are proceeding according to scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards.
Manages project/program issues and risks to mitigate impact to baseline.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's Degree or 5+ years working in a managed care healthcare system or health plan
5+ years of Project Management experience working with large size initiatives.
2+ years of experience in Change Management.
Possess a solid understanding of operations, technology, communications, and processes.
Experience working in Medicaid and/or Medicare.
Experience in Claims Lifecycle Initiatives.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs.

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of leadership experience in a matrixed environment
Knowledge of Systems Development Life Cycle, Waterfall, and Agile Development Methodologies.
Experience in business operations or consulting services in a health plan.
Experience with Smartsheet (PM tool) and/or Jira
Experience in Process mapping and workflow design
Experience Identifying root causes and control gaps
Prosci, Six Sigma, and/or Project Management Institute certifications.

Work Location: US Nationwide
Travel Requirements: Up to 10% to Humana office location

In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager
to own how OpenMined plans, tracks, and ships its most ambitious work. You'll work most closely with Ronnie Falcon, Chief Product Officer, and you'll be the person accountable for timelines, dependencies, and delivery across our product, engineering, research, and partnerships teams.

OpenMined runs several high-stakes efforts at once. ScreamingFace
is an open-source toolkit for composing multiple LLMs into systems that beat any single frontier model, with a public leaderboard and a research fellowship. AI Oversight
builds privacy-preserving infrastructure that lets AI labs, auditors, and safety institutes run evaluations without exposing models or data, with pilots alongside frontier labs. These efforts span multiple teams, tools, and funders, and they move fast under real research uncertainty.

Our product leads decide what to build, and our tech leads decide how it's built. You'll own when and in what order it gets delivered. That means turning goals into milestones with real dates, keeping roadmaps current rather than rewriting them once a year, and making our tools a source of truth people trust. It also means telling leadership early when a date is about to slip and what the options are.

This is a technical role. You'll work daily with engineers and researchers on distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, and privacy-enhancing technologies. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the work well enough to break it down, spot risk, and challenge an estimate.

We're an AI-native team. Our engineers ship with AI coding agents, our main codebase releases several times a week, and our tools and habits keep evolving as AI does. We're looking for a seasoned technical program manager who has built and run project management practices for teams like this. You'll bring years of hands-on experience, use AI to make planning, tracking, and reporting faster and lighter, and help OpenMined become a team that is excellent at project management, not one that depends on a single person to do it.

This is an independent contractor engagement, roughly a full-time commitment, with an initial 12-month term we expect to renew. You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time between one hour behind and two hours ahead of ET).

Responsibilities

Own delivery end to end for OpenMined's flagship initiatives (ScreamingFace and AI Oversight), from quarterly goals to milestones, dependencies, and release dates
Design, run, and keep improving our project management practice for an AI-native team: planning, tracking, status reporting, and retros built around how engineers work with AI agents today, and updated as those tools change
Build AI into how we manage projects: use and build AI agents and automations that draft status updates, summarize Linear, GitHub, and meeting activity, flag risks and stale work, and keep plans current with little manual upkeep
Make the whole team better at project management: set standards and templates, coach product and engineering leads, and grow project management skills across the team, laying the groundwork for future project management hires
Turn quarterly OKRs into dated, sequenced plans with product and engineering leads, and keep them current as research results and priorities shift
Run a living product roadmap that is reviewed on a regular cadence and can feed grant proposals and funder reports without a last-minute rewrite
Be the single accountable owner for cross-team dependencies when one initiative spans several boards, teams, or external partners, and chase down blockers yourself before they cause a slip
Own our project management tooling (Linear for engineering, Asana for cross-functional work): set conventions, cut noise, and make sure status in the tools matches reality
Connect code to plans: make sure work in GitHub links to Linear issues across all active repos, and keep PR review, release status, and repo ownership visible
Track and report progress on milestones, cycle time, and OKR key results to leadership, and flag slipping dates early with clear trade-off options
Coordinate external deliverables such as partner pilots, program launches (e.g., our research fellowship), and grant milestones, so commitments to partners and funders are met

Requirements

Must-Haves

7+ years of technical project or program management, delivering complex software with product and engineering teams. Transferable experience, such as a software engineering background, will also be considered
Built or rebuilt a project management practice: set up planning cadences, tooling, and standards that a team kept using, earned buy-in through credibility rather than heavy process, and raised others' project management skills
Has shaped project management for AI-native teams: worked with engineers who build with AI coding agents, and changed processes as those workflows evolved
Uses AI in their own project management work every day: has built or set up AI agents, automations, or workflows for status reporting, risk detection, planning, or tracker hygiene, and can show concrete results
Delivered under continuous shipping and technical uncertainty: R&D, ML/AI, infrastructure, or developer platforms with frequent releases and changing plans
Technical foundation: a computer science or other technical degree, or 3+ years working as a software engineer. Comfortable reading code, PRs, and architecture docs
Deep, hands-on use of engineering trackers such as Linear, Jira, and GitHub. You've designed a team's workflow, not only used one
Clear, concise communication, written and spoken: you can explain status, risk, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and funders

Preferred

Experience working on a fully remote, distributed team
Has mentored or managed other project or program managers, or helped hire them
Experience with LLMs, AI evaluation, AI safety, or privacy-enhancing technologies
Experience at an early-stage startup or research lab where you built the delivery process from scratch
Experience managing grant-funded or partner-funded deliverables, such as reporting milestones to funders
Experience coordinating with external partners on pilots or integrations (e.g., AI labs, research institutions, government)
Open-source project experience, as a contributor or as a project or release manager

Compensation

Contract fee: $76,000 - $96,000 USD annualized, invoiced monthly
Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location

Benefits

Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, focused on social impact rather than profit, offering the chance to make a meaningful difference in the world
Open Source Contribution: Make a real impact by contributing to an Open Source project that benefits a broad community
Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity
Flexible Work Hours: Enjoy the autonomy to structure your work hours around what best fits your life and productivity
Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within the location requirements for this role

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

About The Role

Docker's Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team embeds senior engineers inside our most strategic customers to solve their hardest deployment, integration, and adoption problems. FDEs then bring what they learn back to Docker Product and Engineering so that every customer benefits.

As the Principal Technical Program Manager for FDE, you define what good looks like for the organization and run the business that delivers it. You define the standards for how FDE plans, commits, delivers, and measures quality. You own the operating rhythm, track commitments Docker has made to customers, the commitments Docker Engineering has made to FDE, and the timelines and resourcing behind them.

________________________________________________________________

This is a senior role that works with stakeholders across the business to drive outcomes for Dockers most important customers. FDE is where Docker proves it can deliver for the customers that matter most while the technology around us changes quickly. You will set the standard for how a small team of senior engineers earns and keeps the trust of customers, and you will make what they learn useful to the whole company. The practices you establish will become the model for how Docker engages with its largest, most complex customers.

Responsibilities

Define What Good Looks Like

Define the FDE delivery standards, engagement model, and quality bar, and write them down so engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and engineers.
Decide which metrics matter for FDE, set targets, and revise them as the team learns.
Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable practice and product improvements.

Run the FDE Business

Give executives a clear account of what is on track, what is at risk, what decision is needed, and from whom.
Own FDE capacity management and staffing plans with FDE leadership and recruiting: which engineers are aligned to which customers, where the gaps are, where and when to hire to stay ahead of demand.

Own Customer and Engineering Commitments

Instrument every commitment Docker has made to FDE customers, and every commitment Docker Product and Engineering teams have made to FDE.
Track commitments, map dependencies across teams, and surface risks early enough to act on them.
Negotiate and confirm dates with teams that run on their own planning processes, and hold them to those dates.

Influence Across Docker

Represent FDE with Product and Engineering leadership. Make sure customer needs are well defined using data, and that product decisions map to achievable FDEs action.
Improve the internal processes that slow collaboration between Field, Product, and Engineering, and bring those improvements to the wider company when they work.
Present FDE results and risks to Docker executives and customer stakeholders.

Lead the Program Practice

Set priorities for junior TPMs, define the reporting FDE needs, and mentor them in program management practice.
Choose the tools and standards FDE uses to track work.

_______________________________________________________________________

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of technical program management experience, including 4+ years at Staff level or above, supporting customer-facing engineering, professional services, or field engineering teams.
A track record of delivering commitments on schedule for enterprise customers, including contractual or executive-visible deadlines.
Experience defining standards, quality bars, and operating processes that other teams adopted.
Experience running dependencies across many engineering teams that you do not manage, and getting reliable dates from them through influence.
Strong technical background in cloud platforms, containers, and modern software delivery. You can read a design, challenge an estimate, and tell a real blocker from a vague one.
Experience choosing metrics and setting targets, including working with incomplete data and deciding what is good enough to act on.
Executive communication skills, with the ability to deliver difficult news early and clearly to customer stakeholders, Docker leaders, and engineers.
High agency and comfort working autonomously in a distributed, remote-first company where processes are still being defined.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Occasional travel to customer sites and to Docker team gatherings.

Bonus Qualifications

Prior experience supporting a Forward Deployed Engineering, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, or Customer Engineering organization.
Familiarity with the agentic AI ecosystem, including coding agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and enterprise requirements for security and governance of AI workloads.
Experience with regulated or compliance-driven customers in financial services, healthcare, government, or similar sectors.
Experience at a developer tools, infrastructure software, or platform company.
Familiarity with Docker products, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development platforms.

What Success Looks Like

FDE has written delivery standards, a quality bar, and KPI targets that FDEs, Field, Product, and Engineering all know and use.
Every customer commitment and every Docker engineering commitment to FDE has an owner and a date, and strategic customer deadlines are met.
FDE operating reviews run weekly, produce decisions, and close their actions.
FDE capacity, hiring, and customer alignment are planned ahead of demand.

new_jobs.description:
LOCATION: Open to a Remote candidate

Job Summary

This role is an essential member of the Global Commercial team and is responsible for positively impacting growth, opportunity conversion, and the overall success of the Mixing Solutions business by developing, deploying, and sustaining a disciplined Global Large Projects Program.

The position will develop a structured process leveraging the SPX FLOW Sales Process to ensure all required steps are followed as opportunities move from prospecting, exploring, and qualifying through pursuit, proposal, negotiation, and order capture. The role will interface with key sales leaders and commercial tools, including Industrial Info Resources (IIR) for prospecting and SAP C4C for opportunity management, to improve visibility, consistency, and accountability across the global large project pipeline.

Once rolled out, this role will lead communication, coaching, cadence management, opportunity review discipline, and continuous improvement of the process. The role will also support sales leads and market managers with intelligence gathering from customers, EPCs, industry sources, and web-based resources, while challenging the organization to define, record, and action the winning moves required to improve project capture.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

The Global Large Projects Program Manager is responsible for all aspects of developing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving the global large projects sales management process.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities Include

Develop and implement a standardized Global Large Projects Management Process aligned with the SPX FLOW Sales Process.
Define stage expectations, qualification criteria, ownership, reviews, and escalation points for large project opportunities.
Drive disciplined progression from prospecting and qualification through pursuit, proposal, negotiation, and order capture.
Create process documentation, templates, training materials, dashboards, and communication packs for global rollout.
Use IIR to identify capital projects, customer investments, EPC activity, and market developments early.
Ensure SAP C4C opportunity data is created, maintained, updated, and reviewed consistently across regions.
Partner with Sales Leadership and Commercial Excellence to improve CRM discipline, pipeline visibility, forecasting, and stage progression.
Maintain global and regional project review cadence against agreed qualification and pursuit standards.
Coach sales leads on process use, opportunity planning, and actions to improve win probability.
Challenge teams to define, assign, and complete winning actions across customer access, technical positioning, value proposition, competitive strategy, EPC engagement, and decision-maker mapping.
Work with Global Market Managers to gather and interpret intelligence from customers, EPCs, consultants, databases, trade press, web resources, and internal feedback.
Coordinate strategic pursuits across regional sales, market management, application engineering, product management, operations, and leadership.
Maintain dashboards and reports tracking pipeline value, quality, stage, qualification status, action completion, and regional performance.
Promote disciplined qualification of opportunities, customer engagement, accountability, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement.
Travel globally as required for customer, EPC, internal business, and industry event visits.

METRICS & DELIVERABLES

Pipeline Growth: Track large project pipeline growth in target markets and priority regions.
Pipeline Quality: Improve the share of qualified, winnable opportunities.
Opportunity Progression: Monitor stage movement and actions to advance stalled opportunities.
Process Adoption: Track rollout, training, review cadence, and C4C standards adoption.
CRM Discipline: Improve data quality, opportunity completeness, action tracking, next steps, and forecast reliability.
Prospecting Effectiveness: Improve early opportunity identification through IIR, customer intelligence, EPC engagement, and research.
Winning Actions: With the team: define, assign, track, and complete critical pursuit actions.
Market Intelligence: Report intelligence on target customers, projects, EPCs, competitors, and investment trends.
Commercial Reviews: Run global and regional reviews with clear outputs and follow-up actions.
Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps and barriers, then implement corrective actions.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong understanding of complex industrial sales processes, project pursuit, opportunity qualification, and pipeline management.
Experience developing, implementing, and improving structured commercial or sales processes in a global industrial environment.
Ability to influence, coach, and challenge sales teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret pipeline data, market intelligence, customer activity, and commercial performance trends.
Confident user of CRM and commercial reporting tools; SAP C4C experience preferred.
Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and training skills.
Strong project management and change management capability.
Ability to develop clear processes, templates, dashboards, reports, and executive-level summaries.
Commercially astute, customer focused, and able to identify what creates a winnable position in complex sales opportunities.
Comfortable working across regions, cultures, functions, and time zones.
Self-motivated, structured, and able to manage multiple priorities with a continuous improvement mindset.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Sales Management, or a related field preferred.
7+ years of relevant experience in industrial sales, commercial excellence, business development, market management, project pursuit, sales operations, or strategic account management.
Experience supporting or leading large capital project pursuits in industrial equipment, process technology, mining, minerals, chemicals, food and beverage, energy, or related sectors preferred.
Experience with CRM deployment, sales process governance, pipeline management, and cross-functional commercial change initiatives preferred.
Previous experience operating in a global matrix organization preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; use computer equipment; and talk or hear. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, travel, and visit customer, EPC, or SPX FLOW sites. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Working conditions are normal for an office environment with regular virtual interaction across global teams. Travel to customer locations, EPC offices, industry events, and SPX FLOW facilities may be required. Customer and project sites can be unpredictable, and associated site-specific safety requirements and protective equipment must be followed accordingly.

QUALITY

Quality encompasses all aspects of SPX FLOW's business, and every employee shares responsibility to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformity relating to products, processes, and quality systems. All employees have an obligation to identify and record any such nonconformity and, through designed channels, initiate and recommend solutions.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Collaborates with management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to establish and refine scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals. Manages technical programs and moderately complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Manages moderately complex issues, bottlenecks, and risks within the scope of work, escalating when necessary. Contributes to and initiates improvements to technical programs, driving the implementation of industry best practices and moderately complex process improvements. Adapts and applies continuous improvement methods within technical programs, identifying insights within assigned workstreams to support generating recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies. Leads technical discussions within the immediate team to align priorities and facilitate collaboration on program goals. Leverages technical expertise to guide cross-functional teams. Collaborates with development teams to enhance reports, dashboards, forecasts, tools, and models. Facilitates collaboration as a technical liason with or between stakeholders teams by ensuring smooth communication and program tracking.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Actively supports product or service delivery and ensures they meet the applicable third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Participates in rapid response to security escalations, identifying risks and appropriate mitigation strategies and supporting the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Forecasts program demands and resourcing to identify risks and ensure that goals are achievable.

– Contributes to the development and implementation of process improvements to improve the reliability of products or services.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Analyzes requirements and provides input on program strategy development.

– Helps refine and update delivery standards and guidelines.

– Identifies and quantifies opportunities for process automations and advocates for prioritization.

– Participates in incident management initiatives, as applicable.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Assists in aligning priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to leadership.

– Collaborates with cross-functional teams to establish and refine scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals.

– Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for program performance against established goals (e.g., scope, timelines, deliverable quality).

– Builds a clear communication strategy of objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Manages both technical and non-technical programs and moderately complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Drives the work of program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), identifying and mitigating barriers, including risks and issues in workflows and technical support.

– Ensures collection and maintenance of program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and identifies risks and issues.

– Ensures attention to detail in program management, from thorough planning to execution and reporting.

– Fosters communication across teams.

– Identifies and addresses operational challenges that impact team adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity targets.

– Participates in forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Deploys change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, or requirement changes.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Manages moderately complex issues, bottlenecks, and risks within the scope of work, escalating when necessary.

– Assesses costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI), informing decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Manages critical issues, making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.

– Collaborates across teams to remove blockers for the program and leverage technical and resource options to ensure successful solution delivery and adoption.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Contributes to and initiates improvements to programs, driving the implementation of industry best practices and moderately complex process improvements.

– Organizes and documents program objectives, workflows, responsibilities, and accountability while implementing cross-functional solutions to address business problems.

– Collaborates with management to develop and refine processes and procedures.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Adapts and applies continuous improvement methods within programs, identifying insights within assigned workstreams to support generating recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies.

– Advances business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Leads discussions within the immediate team to align priorities and facilitate collaboration on program goals.

– Works on small-scale process improvements, analyzing existing processes and proposing refinements to enhance team efficiency.

– Communicates program updates, risks, and opportunities within the team and related stakeholders to facilitate decision-making.

– Engages with stakeholders within and outside the team, collecting input to support program execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Participates in leading programs to enhance organizational efficiency.

– Leverages technical expertise to guide cross-functional teams.

– Drives change across the team.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Collaborates with development teams to enhance reports, dashboards, forecasts, tools, and models.

– Contributes to the utilization of data to solve problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a small number of data sources with minimal complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Facilitates collaboration with or between stakeholders teams by ensuring smooth communication and program tracking.

– Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to monitor progress toward program goals.

– Identifies and documents stakeholder needs and works cross-functionally to implement solutions that enhance satisfaction.

– Assesses risks to customer satisfaction and evaluates mitigation efforts, providing solutions to the immediate team to ensure alignment on resolving these risks.

– Helps coordinate team priorities and ensure coverage to effectively respond to immediate customer needs.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

– Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Collaboration & Partnership:

– Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:

– Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Continuous Learning:

– Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

Continuous Improvement:

– Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.
