World Resources Institute (WRI) Indonesia is an independent, nonprofit research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. WRI Indonesia works with government, businesses, civil society, research institutions, and development partners to advance evidence-based policies and solutions for sustainable development.

Through its work on plastic pollution and the circular economy, WRI Indonesia supports Indonesia and relevant stakeholders in strengthening policies, institutions, and implementation mechanisms to reduce plastic pollution and promote a more inclusive and sustainable packaging system. Mandatory Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) is an important policy instrument for strengthening producers' responsibility for the post-consumer management of packaging. Effective implementation requires an enabling ecosystem that connects packaging design, recycled-content markets, alternative materials, reuse and refill systems, financing mechanisms, waste management infrastructure, and inclusive participation across the value chain.

Job Highlight

Role

The Research Analyst will support the delivery of a research package to strengthen mandatory Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) for packaging in Indonesia. The role will contribute to data collection, analysis, and drafting across three interconnected research workstreams:

Sustainable packaging ecosystem and governance: Assessment of recycled-content markets, alternative packaging materials, and reuse/refill systems, including recommendations for policy interventions, implementation roadmaps, and traceability frameworks.
Strengthening mandatory EPR for packaging: Assessment of policy scenarios and their implications for EPR costs, contributions from non-obliged companies, greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and eco-modulation mechanisms.
Equity and just transition: Analysis of formal and informal sector value chains, socioeconomic and employment impacts, social protection, and gender equality, disability, and social inclusion (GEDSI), with recommendations for an inclusive transition (including GEDSI guideline for EPR implementation).

What You Will Do

Research, Data Analysis, and Writing (75%)

Conduct literature reviews, policy and regulatory analysis on EPR for packaging, recycled-content policies, eco-modulation, traceability, reuse/refill, and just transition.
Collect, clean, and manage primary and secondary data on packaging placed on the market, waste generation, collection and recycling rates, recycled-resin prices and offtake, and waste management costs. Maintain a clear log of data sources, assumptions, and limitations.
Develop and run spreadsheet-based models and scenario calculations for EPR costs, recycled-content targets, and GHG emissions (e.g., material flow analysis, emission factors, cost-per-tonne estimates) under the direction of the Managers and Senior Research Lead.
Map packaging and recycling value chains, including producers, producer responsibility organizations, recyclers, aggregators (lapak/pelapak), waste banks (bank sampah), and informal waste workers.
Support the design and test data collection tools (e.g. interview guides, survey questionnaires, FGD protocols), and conduct interviews, field visits, and focus group discussions, collecting sex- and disability-disaggregated data where relevant.
Analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and develop tables, charts, maps, and infographics to communicate findings clearly.
Draft assigned sections, annexes, and summaries for three technical knowledge products, incorporating feedback from Senior Research Lead, peer reviewers, and donor representative.

Stakeholder Engagement, Coordination, and Administrative Support (25%)

Coordinate logistic for technical consultations, interviews, workshops, and validation meetings with government ministries and agencies, private sector representatives, producer responsibility organizations, industry associations, recyclers, civil society organizations, research institutions, and informal sector representatives.
Prepare background notes, meeting materials, and presentations, and documenting consultation findings and agreed follow-up actions.
Maintain organized stakeholder contact list, consultation records, and research files in accordance with WRI’s data management and research ethics procedures.
Support the preparation of policy briefs, slide decks, blogs, and other short products that share research findings with government, donors, and the public.
Support work planning, progress tracking, and donor reporting for the research package.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, economics, public policy, development studies, sustainability, social sciences, or other relevant field.
Minimum 4 (four) years of relevant professional experience in applied research, policy analysis, circular economy, waste management, sustainable packaging, or related fields.
Sound understanding of EPR, plastic pollution, recycling markets, and circular economy concepts, as well as Indonesia's waste management, packaging, and environmental policy landscape.
Demonstrate strong quantitative research skills, including data cleaning, analysis, and spreadsheet modelling in Excel. Experience with R, Python, Stata, or similar tools is an advantage.
Experience or training in at least one of the following areas: material flow analysis, cost analysis, GHG accounting, or life-cycle assessment.
Experience conducting qualitative research, including interviews, focus group discussions, and fieldwork, ideally with informal sector workers or communities.
Demonstrate understanding of gender equality, disability, and social inclusion (GEDSI) and how to incorporate these considerations into research design, data collection, and analysis.
Demonstrate strong research writing skills, with experience contributing to technical reports, policy briefs, or other research publications.
Demonstrate the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-specialist audiences using written and visual formats
Well organised, pay close attention to detail, and able to maintain multiple competing priorities.
Work well in a team and be comfortable engaging with government, private sector, civil society, and community stakeholders.
Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English on both verbal and written communications
Ability and willingness to travel as required
Legally able to work in Indonesia

Duration

1 December 2026 – 31 December 2027

Deliverables

The Research Analyst will contribute to the timely, high-quality delivery of the three technical knowledge products below, working under the technical lead of the Senior Research Lead.

Deliverable 1: Draft of Technical Report on Building the Ecosystem and Governance for Sustainable Packaging

The Report Will Assess And Recommend Ways To Build a Sustainable Packaging Ecosystem In Indonesia, Covering Demand For Recycled Content, Recycled-content Targets, Traceability, And Ecomodulation Framework. The Research Analyst Will Support It By

Supporting research and analysis on recycled content target-setting and scenario, traceability, and ecomodulation frameworks.
General support in data collection and research writing
Deliverable 2: Draft of Technical Paper on Strengthening Mandatory EPR for Packaging.

The Paper Will Assess Policy Scenarios For Mandatory EPR And Their Effects On System Costs, Contributions From Non-obliged Companies, GHG Emissions, And Eco-modulation. The Research Analyst Will Support It By

Supporting EPR for packaging research through cost data collection and scenario analysis, profiling non-obliged companies and developing their contribution mechanisms, assessing GHG impacts and alignment with national and corporate climate targets.
Deliverable 3: Draft of Technical Paper on Equity and Just Transition in Mandatory EPR for Packaging

The Paper Will Set Out a Pathway Toward a Just And Inclusive EPR System, Including GEDSI Guidelines. The Research Analyst Will Support It By

Supporting interviews and focus group discussions with various stakeholders

For all deliverables, the Research Analyst will also provide the following supporting outputs:

A shared, well-organised evidence base: literature review matrix, datasets, and model files with a documented assumptions log.
Interview, consultation, and validation notes in an agreed format.
Charts, tables, infographics, and slide decks for presentations and dissemination.
Short monthly progress updates to the Research Lead.

Terms of Payment

Daily rate-based consultant with a maximum of 20 (twenty) working days per month

How To Apply

Please submit a resume with a cover letter by 12 November 2026. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates.
Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position.
Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed.
This is a locally engaged position, Indonesian nationals are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer

Consultant rate that is commensurate with experience and skill.
Travel insurance for both domestic and international for any travel duty as assigned by WRI Indonesia
Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields.
A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work
The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI
Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours

About Us

World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.

Our Mission And Values

WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations.

Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership, and Care.

Our Culture

WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Our Human Resources Team carefully reviews all applications.

Global Business Services & Operations is at the core of TD Securities. We are a dynamic, multi-faceted division that partners with all parts of the Dealer, including Sales & Trading to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients globally. Global Business Services & Operations recruits highly motivated individuals who can help the Dealer and our clients facilitate business. Professionals in Global Business Services & Operations come from a variety of academic and professional backgrounds.

The successful candidate will be part of the Client Due Diligence team within Global Business Services & Operations. The Client Due Diligence team is committed to ensuring services provided across the Bank and to its clients are delivered in a professional manner, that risk is minimized, and the client has a positive experience. The candidate is expected to think creatively, improve the daily process, and take responsibility and ownership for this to happen.

Team Overview

The Client Due Diligence (CDD) team conducts due diligence on TD Securities clients during onboarding, periodic reviews, and on an ongoing basis. The team ensures compliance with Global AML, specifically under Canada and U.S. regulatory requirements, mitigating operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.

Job Description/Accountabilities

Lead departmental projects: Drive process improvements, system enhancements, and risk mitigation initiatives for CDD operations.
Oversee the team's workload: Ensure requests are managed in a timely manner and escalate issues as needed to maintain compliance and efficiency.
Manage work queues for onboarding and ensure adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) while maintaining quality standards.
Assist with onboarding requests: Continue to work on client onboarding, periodic reviews, and ad-hoc requests, ensuring compliance with KYC, FATCA, CIRO, and AML requirements.
Mentor and train new team members, providing guidance on AML requirements and promoting adherence to regulatory standards.
Handle complex cases: Perform secondary reviews of AML analysis, ensuring thoroughness, accuracy, and proper risk assessment.
Manage escalations: Address complex or high-priority cases by working with business partners and ensuring the team adheres to SLAs.
Lead audit and regulatory exam preparation: Coordinate efforts for audits by collecting, analyzing, and presenting required data.
Support strategic initiatives: Participate in the rollout and development of new processes, systems, and operational enhancements across the department.
Identify areas of concern: Work closely with the manager to identify and address areas of concern, whether from a KYC perspective or any other challenges the department is facing.
Drive adherence to AML standards: Ensure all team members understand and comply with AML regulations, including KYC, FATCA, CIRO, and CRS.
Participate in the rollout and adoption of new operational and regulatory initiatives within the team.
Handle competing priorities: Be willing and able to juggle multiple tasks with competing deadlines and priorities while ensuring a high level of performance.

Job Requirements

Advanced knowledge of AML regulations, including PCMLTFA, FATCA, CIRO, and broader AML trends.
Leadership skills: Ability to lead and mentor a team, guide junior members, and manage escalations effectively.
Project management experience: Capable of managing or contributing to projects focused on process improvement, system enhancements, or regulatory compliance.
Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking: Ability to handle complex tasks with competing priorities while ensuring consistent delivery.
Proficiency with data analysis tools, including Excel, Bloomberg, Impact, UI Path, Alteryx, and VBA is preferred.
Exceptional communication skills, able to influence team members and business partners.
CAMS designation is an asset.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

new_jobs.title: Population Health and VBC Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Population Health and Value-Based Care Manager is responsible for developing and implementing strategies to optimize health outcomes for diverse populations served by Adelante Healthcare. This role includes overseeing population health initiatives, managing value-based care programs, and ensuring compliance with relevant healthcare regulations. This position will be responsible for coordinating with the patient care teams and operational management as well as monitoring and driving the program's financial performance. The incumbent of this position must understand the balance between finances and patient care and be capable of prioritizing accordingly. Additionally, the manager will cultivate partnerships with health plans to support value-based care models.

EXPECTATIONS

Every Adelante Healthcare leader will strive to maximize the performance and contribution of each team member of Adelante Healthcare and the community that we serve every day. Leaders are expected to set clear performance expectations, establish specific measurable goals for team members to drive accountability and success, provide ongoing feedback and coaching to enhance performance, improve results and outcomes. Leaders are also expected to work in a manner that demonstrates a commitment to our mission, vision, core values quality, patient safety, employee engagement, innovation, and model for all other employees the highest standards of personal integrity, professionalism, and competence.

OUR CORE VALUES

Inclusion
Nurture
Service
Purposeful
Integrity
Resilient
Engaged

Qualifications

ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

An associate’s degree in applied sciences or equivalent
Minimum of three (3) years of experience in population health management, value-based care, or healthcare administration, ideally within an FQHC or similar setting.
High level of experience with HEDIS, UDS, AZARA, network portals, Care Gaps closure, Data analysis, attestation forms, and performance improvement.
In-depth understanding of population health principles, value-based care models, and quality improvement processes.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and healthcare data management systems.
Proven ability to build partnerships with health plans and understand value-based care agreements.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
Proficient in healthcare quality improvement methodologies and community health assessment frameworks.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external customers.
Valid Level One Fingerprint Clearance Card issued by the Arizona Department of Public Safety.
Certification to perform cardiopulmonary Resuscitation for the Health Care Professional (CPR) and AED through courses that follow the guidelines from the American Heart Association and Red Cross (cognitive and skills evaluations).
Valid Arizona Driver’s License
Travel to all health centers if required.

Position Reponsibilities/Essential

Compliance with Regulatory Standards:

Collaborate with Provider Network Manager to ensure Adherence with Networks contracted with Adelante.
Ensure Adherence with The National Committee for Quality Assurance to improve the quality of healthcare.
Ensure adherence to HRSA (Health Resources and Services Administration) guidelines related to population health and value-based care initiatives.
Implement and maintain practices that comply with Arizona Department of Health regulations and Joint Commission standards.
Ensure Population Health & Health Centers working on VBC conduct regular evaluations and audits to verify compliance, identify areas for improvement, and document progress on quality initiatives.

Education And Training

Schedule training for health centers’ key stakeholders to ensure proper use of codes and closure of care gaps.
Provide training and support to staff on population health management practices, value-based care principles, and relevant data analysis tools.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions aimed at enhancing organizational understanding of population health initiatives and their impact on patient care.

Collaborative Efforts

Foster strong relationships with healthcare providers, community organizations, health plans, and stakeholders to promote integrated healthcare solutions.
Participate in community health initiatives aimed at improving access to care, addressing social determinants of health, and enhancing community well-being.

POPULATION HEALTH PROGRAM

Develop, implement, and monitor population health management strategies that address specific health needs within the community, particularly for high-risk and underserved populations.
Conduct data analysis to identify health disparities and target interventions for specific populations aimed at improving health outcomes and access to care.
Design and implement programs to promote preventive care, chronic disease management, and early intervention strategies.
Collaborate with healthcare providers and community organizations to align resources and services to support population health initiatives.
Pull data of metrics and benchmarks to evaluate the effectiveness of population health programs, adjust strategies based on performance data, and report outcomes to stakeholders.
Compile and report outcomes to stakeholders, including success of initiatives, provide insights into program adjustments, and illustrate the impact on community health.

VBC PROGRAM

Financial Tracking And Analysis

Collaborate with the Senior Manager of Nursing Department and Medical Areas or Operations Manager to develop and manage financial models to assess the financial viability of value-based care initiatives and track the financial performance of each plan.
Partner with Operational Value Based Care teammates to optimize efforts for closing care gaps in Medicaid, Medicare, and Commercial patient populations, in that order of priority.
Partner with Data Analytics department, IT, Clinical and Operational Leadership to maintain accurate patient rosters for the value-based care programs.
Collect and communicate Value-Based Care quality results and strategies as needed to Senior Manager of Nursing Department and Quality Improvement.
Prepare and manage budgets for value-based care programs and monitor adherence to financial targets.
Develop key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the financial performance of value-based care programs and partner with operational leadership to achieve results.
Collaborate with and Provider Network Manager to Identify financial risks associated with value-based care contracts and develop strategies to mitigate them.
Work to maximize revenue through effective care coordination, patient engagement, and quality improvement initiatives in coordination with Operational and Clinical Management.
Utilize data analytics and partner with the Data Analytics Team to assess the financial performance of value-based care programs and identify areas for improvement.
Educate staff and healthcare providers about the financial aspects of value-based care and how their actions can impact financial outcomes.
Prepare reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices in value-based care and healthcare finance.
Collaborate with the provider network manager to Implement a clear and rigorous system for segregating VBC payments from the regular FQHC PPS prospective payments. This can involve creating separate accounts or financial codes to track VBC income separately.
Stay up to date with federal and state regulations of FQHC funding and reporting requirements, ensuring that VBC payments do not compromise the FQHC's compliance and remain separate from PPS.
Collaborate with the provider network manager to generate detailed financial reports that clearly distinguish VBC payments from prospective payments to maintain transparency in financial reporting.
Collaborate with the Provider Network Manager, CSML in the review process of VBC contracts to understand the terms, conditions, and performance measures associated with these agreements. Ensure that any financial incentives align with the FQHC's mission and goals.

Accountable Care Organization Tracking & Analysis

Collaborate with the Provider Network Manager to build a robust, well-documented system for managing all standard ACO operations, including CMS-mandated reporting, patient and provider communications, payments of claims, and maintenance of compliance.
Collaborated with Nursing Department and operations to align and collect KPIs data; determine insights and performance-improving actions items based on analysis and tracking of indicator reporting.
Determine how best to use data and analytics to inform effective strategic decision-making around ACO operations.
Other projects as requested by the Senior Manager of Nursing Department and Quality Improvement.

VBC HEALTH PLANS AUDIT PROGRAM

Ensure timely execution of audit requests by developing and implementing a robust, well-documented system for responding to health plan audits.
Develop improvement plans, if necessary, based on internal tracers, identifying trends, and identifying problematic areas.
Responsible for overseeing Adelante Healthcare's Health Plans Audit Program.

Nonessential Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Additional Duties And Responsibilities

Other duties as requested or assigned.

Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) and Integrated Care Team (ICT)

All employees are responsible for promoting and participating in interdisciplinary communication and collaboration to enhance the delivery of quality across the health care system. Employees should maintain an environment which supports and engages patients and co-workers in a caring team-based model to promote wellness and improve health outcomes.

Adherence to Compliance and Code of Conduct

All employees are required to comply with Adelante Healthcare’s written standards, including its Compliance Program and Code of Conduct, policies and procedures and reporting of any conduct that potentially violates Adelante’s legal or compliance requirements. Such compliance will be an element considered as part of the regular performance evaluation.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be required to sit for long periods of time, is required to stand, walk, use hands to handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb steps/stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; smell; manage stress as it relates to essential job functions. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds without assistance and may occasionally be required to lift or move up to 50 pounds with assistance. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work environment:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to weather conditions prevalent at the time when traveling to various clinic sites. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The employee may be subject to health hazards (contagious diseases, blood borne pathogens, etc.) when working in the clinic area.

Curious – a strong desire to dig to and understand the root cause of problems (5x why)

The GBF GTM Operations Analyst supports the planning and ongoing management of sales territories, quotas, and incentive compensation, translating go-to-market strategy into balanced territory coverage, accurate sales targets, and effective compensation plans.

The analyst will support an assigned business portfolio and help manage the compensation-planning lifecycle from annual target and plan development through ongoing maintenance, reporting, replans, and compensation-related business support.

Working closely with Business Operations, Finance, and compensation teams, the successful candidate will combine analytical problem solving, operational discipline, and sound judgement to manage established processes independently and recommend solutions to complex business issues. They will also use AI and automation to simplify processes, strengthen controls, and improve accuracy and efficiency.

Simplify and standardize processes, using analytics, AI tools, and workflow automation to reduce manual work, improve reporting, and strengthen operational controls.

The Treasury team is part of Circana’s global Finance and Strategy organization and manages a broad range of operational and strategic activities, including cash management, banking, liquidity planning, capital structure, and financial risk management. The team supports approximately 25 countries and partners closely with Controllership, Tax, Legal, and Financial Planning & Analysis.

As the OUS Treasury Operations Analyst, you will serve as the primary resource for daily Treasury Operations outside the United States. You will independently manage core cash processes, including daily cash positioning, Treasury transactions, forecasting, reporting, banking administration, and operational controls across a complex international environment.

You will review and interpret cash activity, identify liquidity or operational concerns, and recommend improvements to cash visibility, forecast accuracy, processes, and controls. The role requires close partnership with the OUS Treasury Operations Manager, local Controllers, global banking partners, and teams across Controllership, Tax, Legal, and FP&A.

This role reports to the OUS Treasury Operations Manager and supports Treasury activities across approximately 25 countries. The OUS and US Analysts will cross-train and provide backup coverage for one another.

Job Responsibilities

Prepare and review daily OUS cash positioning, analyzing cash movements and identifying liquidity risks, funding needs, or unusual activity requiring escalation.
Execute Treasury transactions, including wires, ACH payments, and intercompany transfers, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to authorization and control requirements.
Own key components of daily, weekly, and monthly cash forecasting, including gathering and validating inputs, analyzing variances, and recommending improvements to forecast reliability.
Monitor cash across countries, currencies, legal entities, and banking platforms to support liquidity decisions and timely funding.
Partner with local Controllers, banks, Tax, Legal, Controllership, and FP&A to resolve cash-related issues and support international Treasury activities.
Review daily bank activity and partner with Controllership and local Finance teams to investigate and resolve cash or reconciliation exceptions.
Maintain bank account and authorized-signer documentation and support account openings, closures, and administrative updates across international banking partners.
Administer user access and entitlements within online banking platforms and Treasury systems in accordance with security and control requirements.
Monitor intercompany loan balances and maintain supporting schedules, ensuring accurate records and visibility into internal funding activity.
Prepare and enhance Treasury reporting, providing clear insights into cash trends, forecast variances, liquidity needs, and operational drivers.
Identify risks or issues within international Treasury processes and determine the appropriate stakeholders and escalation path.
Identify and support practical improvements to Treasury processes, controls, workflows, data quality, and operational efficiency.
Support Treasury systems and automation initiatives, including testing, documentation, and implementation of system enhancements.
Support audit, compliance, and documentation requirements, ensuring adherence to internal policies and control standards.
Participate in Treasury projects, cross-training, and process documentation initiatives.
Provide backup coverage for US Treasury Operations as needed.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in Treasury, banking, or a related finance or accounting role with meaningful exposure to cash management.
Hands-on experience with cash positioning, liquidity management, cash forecasting, corporate banking activity, or related Treasury processes.
Experience supporting Treasury activities across multiple countries, currencies, legal entities, or banking environments is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of cash management, financial statements, cash flow, and liquidity concepts.
Ability to analyze cash activity, identify trends or exceptions, and make practical recommendations.
Ability to independently investigate operational issues, identify the appropriate stakeholders, and escalate concerns when needed.
Experience working with treasury management systems, ERP platforms, or corporate online banking systems. Kyriba and NetSuite experience are preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and data analysis.
Strong attention to detail and ability to execute accurately within established controls and deadlines.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring daily responsibilities across multiple countries and time zones.
Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to work across local and global Finance teams.
Problem-solving skills and willingness to investigate discrepancies, clarify requirements, and resolve operational issues.
Ability to provide Treasury coverage during US banking hours, with occasional flexibility to support stakeholders in other global time zones.

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.

new_jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst III
new_jobs.description:
We are so glad you are interested in joining Sutter Health!

Organization

SHSO-Sutter Health System Office-Valley

Position Overview

THIS POSITION IS REQUIRED TO WORK ONSITE 2 DAYS PER WEEK IN SACRAMENTO

An advanced analytical professional who exercises independent judgment to solve complex business questions. Requires both domain or business and technical analytics expertise. As a deep domain subject matter expert, this role builds predictive models, delivers actionable insights, and leads project teams to drive specific operational or financial decisions. This position is an independent professional contributor within their respective department or business unit. Bridges the gap between raw data and actionable strategy. Focuses on business value—leading business and technical requirements gathering, building rapid proofs-of-concept (POCs), and presenting data-driven recommendations to operational leaders. Working with minimal oversight, this role applies advanced analytical skills to novel business problems where no clear procedure exists and informally mentors junior team members.

Education

Job Description
:

[Equivalent experience will be accepted in lieu of the required degree or diploma

Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field

Certification & Licensure

Epic Cogito Certification within one year of start date.
One tool-specific certification (Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate OR Tableau Certified Data Analyst) within one year of start date.

Typical Experience

5 years recent relevant experience.

Skills And Knowledge

Progressive experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Proven experience independently solving complex business problems using advanced analytics and predictive modeling.
Strong experience building advanced models and dashboards in a primary visualization tool (Tableau or Power BI).
Experience writing advanced SQL queries for complex data exploration and extraction.
Experience leading small-to-medium analytical projects.
Analytics: Advanced understanding of statistical analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling concepts.
Tools: Advanced proficiency in data visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI) or in application tools and advanced Excel modeling.
Data Access: Advanced SQL skills (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, CTEs) for independent data extraction and exploration.
Communication: Excellent data storytelling and presentation skills; ability to influence non-technical stakeholders.
Problem Solving: Strong ability to exercise independent judgment and tackle novel, ambiguous business questions.
